chinese: 他穿着一条黑色的裤子。
pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yì tiáo hēisè de kùzi.
english: He was wearing a pair of black trousers.

chinese: 教室的门开着。
pinyin: Jiàoshì de mén kāizhe.
english: The classroom door was open.

chinese: 他们唱着歌，跳着舞，非常高兴。
pinyin: Tāmen chàngzhe gē, tiàozhe wǔ, fēicháng gāoxìng.
english: They were singing and dancing, and were having a wonderful time.

chinese: 她怎么不在家呢？
pinyin: Tā zěnme bú zài jiā ne?
english: Why isn't she at home?

chinese: 明天你想去哪儿呢？
pinyin: Míngtiān nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr ne?
english: Where would you like to go tomorrow?

chinese: 这是你的手机吧？
pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de shǒujī ba?
english: Is this your mobile, by any chance?

chinese: 这么晚了，超市已经关门了吧？
pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, chāoshì yǐjīng guānmén le ba?
english: It's so late – I suppose the supermarket's closed by now, isn't it?

chinese: 我是去年九月来中国的。
pinyin: Wǒ shì qùnián jiǔ yuè lái Zhōngguó de.
english: I came to China last September.

chinese: 我们是在北京认识的。
pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài Běijīng rènshi de.
english: We met in Beijing.

chinese: 他们是坐飞机去上海的。
pinyin: Tāmen shì zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi de.
english: They flew to Shanghai.

chinese: 今天的晚饭是我做的。
pinyin: Jīntiān de wǎnfàn shì wǒ zuò de.
english: I cooked dinner tonight.

chinese: 你汉语说得真好啊！
pinyin: Nǐ Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn hǎo a!
english: Your Chinese is really excellent!

chinese: 听懂、回去、跑得很快、等一下
pinyin: Tīngdǒng, huíqù, pǎo de hěn kuài, děng yíxià
english: Understood, go back, run very fast, wait a moment

chinese: 老师的、白色的、便宜的、妈妈做的
pinyin: Lǎoshī de, báisè de, piányi de, māma zuò de
english: The teacher's, white, cheap, made by Mum

chinese: 来上课、去上海旅游、坐地铁去学校
pinyin: Lái shàng kè, qù Shànghǎi lǚyóu, zuò dìtiě qù xuéxiào
english: Attend classes, go on a trip to Shanghai, take the underground to university

chinese: 请他来、叫朋友帮忙、让妈妈洗衣服
pinyin: Qǐng tā lái, jiào péngyou bāngmáng, ràng māma xǐ yīfu
english: Invite him round, ask a friend for help, ask Mum to do the washing

chinese: 新电脑、老师的书、火车票、一个男孩、两条、这间
pinyin: Xīn diànnǎo, lǎoshī de shū, huǒchēpiào, yí ge nánhái, liǎng tiáo, zhè jiān
english: A new computer, the teacher's book, a train ticket, a boy, two, this room

chinese: 写汉字、听懂、回去、经常上网、可以进去
pinyin: Xiě Hànzì, tīngdǒng, huíqù, jīngcháng shàngwǎng, kěyǐ jìnqù
english: Write Chinese characters, understand, go home, go online frequently, be able to go in

chinese: 很累、非常忙、慢一点儿
pinyin: Hěn lèi, fēicháng máng, màn yìdiǎnr
english: I'm exhausted, really busy – take it easy

chinese: 他喜欢唱歌、跳舞什么的。
pinyin: Tā xǐhuan chànggē, tiàowǔ shénme de.
english: He likes singing, dancing and things like that.

chinese: 足球、篮球什么的，我都喜欢。
pinyin: Zúqiú, lánqiú shénme de, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
english: I like football, basketball and the like.

chinese: 这些菜我都没吃过，还是你点吧。
pinyin: Zhèxiē cài wǒ dōu méi chīguo, háishi nǐ diǎn ba.
english: I've never tried any of these dishes before, so you'd better choose.

chinese: 你还是去医院看看吧。
pinyin: Nǐ háishi qù yīyuàn kànkan ba.
english: You'd better go to the hospital and get it checked out.

chinese: 电影要开始了。
pinyin: Diànyǐng yào kāishǐ le.
english: The film is about to start.

chinese: 我们快要开学了。
pinyin: Wǒmen kuàiyào kāixué le.
english: The new term is about to begin.

chinese: 下星期就要考试了。
pinyin: Xià xīngqī jiù yào kǎoshì le.
english: The exam is next week.

chinese: 都这么晚了，你怎么还不睡觉？
pinyin: Dōu zhème wǎn le, nǐ zěnme hái bú shuìjiào?
english: It's so late – why aren't you in bed yet?

chinese: 都十一点了，别看电视了。
pinyin: Dōu shíyī diǎn le, bié kàn diànshì le.
english: It's already 11 o'clock; stop watching telly.

chinese: 水果都吃完了。
pinyin: Shuǐguǒ dōu chīwán le.
english: We've eaten all the fruit.

chinese: 那本书我看过了。
pinyin: Nà běn shū wǒ kànguo le.
english: I've read that book.

chinese: 她高个子、大眼睛，很漂亮。
pinyin: Tā gāo gèzi, dà yǎnjing, hěn piàoliang.
english: She is tall, has big eyes and is very pretty.

chinese: 王老师上海人，四十多岁。
pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī Shànghǎi rén, sìshí duō suì.
english: Mr Wang is from Shanghai and is in his forties.

chinese: 那个唱歌的女孩儿是谁？
pinyin: Nàge chànggē de nǚháir shì shéi?
english: Who is that girl singing?

chinese: 这就是儿子我学习汉语的学校。
pinyin: Zhè jiùshì érzi wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ de xuéxiào.
english: This is the school where I, the son, am learning Chinese.

chinese: 我还不知道电影开始的时间。
pinyin: Wǒ hái bù zhīdao diànyǐng kāishǐ de shíjiān.
english: I don't know what time the film starts yet.

chinese: 这个字你写错了。
pinyin: Zhège zì nǐ xiěcuò le.
english: You've written that character wrong.

chinese: 老师的话你听懂了吗？
pinyin: Lǎoshī de huà nǐ tīngdǒng le ma?
english: Did you understand what the teacher said?

chinese: 衣服已经洗好了。
pinyin: Yīfu yǐjīng xǐhǎo le.
english: The washing is done.

chinese: 我学会游泳了。
pinyin: Wǒ xuéhuì yóuyǒng le.
english: I've learnt to swim.

chinese: 题太多了，我没做完。
pinyin: Tí tài duō le, wǒ méi zuòwán.
english: There were too many questions; I didn't manage to finish them all.

chinese: 你上来吧，我在楼上等你。
pinyin: Nǐ shànglái ba, wǒ zài lóushàng děng nǐ.
english: Come on up; I'll be waiting for you upstairs.

chinese: 太晚了，你快回去吧。
pinyin: Tài wǎn le, nǐ kuài huíqù ba.
english: It's getting late; you'd better head home.

chinese: 飞机飞上天了。
pinyin: Fēijī fēishàng tiān le.
english: The aeroplane took to the skies.

chinese: 弟弟跑下楼了。
pinyin: Dìdi pǎoxià lóu le.
english: My little brother ran downstairs.

chinese: 老师走进办公室了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zǒujìn bàngōngshì le.
english: The teacher walked into the office.

chinese: 他从包里拿出一本书。
pinyin: Tā cóng bāo lǐ náchū yì běn shū.
english: He took a book out of his bag.

chinese: 我们一起走回学校吧。
pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ zǒuhuí xuéxiào ba.
english: Let's walk back to school together.

chinese: 车开过来了，大家快上车。
pinyin: Chē kāiguòlai le, dàjiā kuài shàng chē.
english: The car's coming; everyone, hop in.

chinese: 她在那边等着呢，咱们走过去吧。
pinyin: Tā zài nàbian děngzhe ne, zánmen zǒuguòqu ba.
english: She's waiting over there; let's go over to her.

chinese: 他从书包里拿出来一本中文书。
pinyin: Tā cóng shūbāo lǐ náchūlai yì běn Zhōngwén shū.
english: He took a Chinese book out of his schoolbag.

chinese: 妈妈从超市买回来一些水果。
pinyin: Māma cóng chāoshì mǎihuílai yìxiē shuǐguǒ.
english: Mum brought some fruit back from the supermarket.

chinese: 王老师我走进教室来了。
pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī wǒ zǒujìn jiàoshì lái le.
english: Mr Wang, I've just walked into the classroom.

chinese: 咱们的车能开进学校去吗？
pinyin: Zánmen de chē néng kāijìn xuéxiào qù ma?
english: Can we drive our car into the school grounds?

chinese: 你可以站起来吗？
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zhànqǐlai ma?
english: Can you stand up?

chinese: 他们怎么还没有走上来？
pinyin: Tāmen zěnme hái méiyǒu zǒushànglai?
english: Why haven't they come up yet?

chinese: 你在楼上等我，我给你送上去。
pinyin: Nǐ zài lóushàng děng wǒ, wǒ gěi nǐ sòngshàngqu.
english: Wait for me upstairs; I'll bring it up to you.

chinese: 他们从山上走下来了。
pinyin: Tāmen cóng shān shàng zǒuxiàlai le.
english: They came down from the mountain.

chinese: 这些东西你帮我拿下去吧。
pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi nǐ bāng wǒ náxiàqu ba.
english: Could you take these things down for me?

chinese: 大家玩儿得很高兴。
pinyin: Dàjiā wánr de hěn gāoxìng.
english: Everyone was having a great time.

chinese: 他篮球打得很好。
pinyin: Tā lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
english: He's very good at basketball.

chinese: 我学了两年中文了。
pinyin: Wǒ xuéle liǎng nián Zhōngwén le.
english: I've been learning Chinese for two years.

chinese: 我等了她一个多小时。
pinyin: Wǒ děngle tā yí ge duō xiǎoshí.
english: I waited for her for over an hour.

chinese: 他们昨天看了一晚上的电视。
pinyin: Tāmen zuótiān kànle yì wǎnshang de diànshì.
english: They watched television all evening yesterday.

chinese: 坐地铁比坐公交车快一些。
pinyin: Zuò dìtiě bǐ zuò gōngjiāochē kuài yìxiē.
english: Taking the underground is a bit quicker than taking the bus.

chinese: 我哥哥比我大两岁。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
english: My brother is two years older than me.

chinese: 她个子很高。
pinyin: Tā gèzi hěn gāo.
english: She is very tall.

chinese: 这件事我知道。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ zhīdao.
english: I'm aware of that.

chinese: 是我自己去，还是你跟我一起去？
pinyin: Shì wǒ zìjǐ qù, háishi nǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù?
english: Shall I go on my own, or are you coming with me?

chinese: 你喜欢打篮球，还是喜欢踢足球？
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú, háishi xǐhuan tī zúqiú?
english: Do you prefer playing basketball or football?

chinese: 下雨了，别出去了。
pinyin: Xià yǔ le, bié chūqù le.
english: It's raining, so don't go out.

chinese: 别忘了，明天有考试。
pinyin: Bié wàng le, míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
english: Don't forget, there's an exam tomorrow.

chinese: 那件衣服是新的。
pinyin: Nà jiàn yīfu shì xīn de.
english: That shirt is new.

chinese: 这个手机是坏的，不能用。
pinyin: Zhège shǒujī shì huài de, bù néng yòng.
english: This mobile phone is faulty and doesn't work.

chinese: 王老师有三十岁吗？
pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī yǒu sānshí suì ma?
english: Is Mr Wang thirty years old?

chinese: 这些水果有一百块钱吗？
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ yǒu yìbǎi kuài qián ma?
english: Do these fruits cost a hundred yuan?

chinese: 门口站着一个人。
pinyin: Ménkǒu zhànzhe yí ge rén.
english: There was a person standing at the door.

chinese: 教室里坐着十几个学生。
pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ zuòzhe shí jǐ ge xuésheng.
english: There were a dozen or so pupils sitting in the classroom.

chinese: 姐姐比我高。
pinyin: Jiějie bǐ wǒ gāo.
english: My sister is taller than me.

chinese: 公交车比地铁便宜。
pinyin: Gōngjiāochē bǐ dìtiě piányi.
english: Buses are cheaper than the underground.

chinese: 哥哥比我大两岁。
pinyin: Gēge bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
english: My brother is two years older than me.

chinese: 咖啡比奶茶贵一点儿。
pinyin: Kāfēi bǐ nǎichá guì yìdiǎnr.
english: Coffee is a little more expensive than milk tea.

chinese: 今天比昨天冷多了。
pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le.
english: It's much colder today than it was yesterday.

chinese: 姐姐的个子比妹妹高得多。
pinyin: Jiějie de gèzi bǐ mèimei gāo de duō.
english: The older sister is much taller than her younger sister.

chinese: 你有他高吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu tā gāo ma?
english: Are you as tall as him?

chinese: 今天没有昨天（那么）冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān méiyǒu zuótiān (nàme) lěng.
english: It isn't (quite) as cold today as it was yesterday.

chinese: 我的汉语没有你（这么）好。
pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ méiyǒu nǐ (zhème) hǎo.
english: My Chinese isn't (as) good as yours.

chinese: 她比我说得好。
pinyin: Tā bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo.
english: She put it better than I did.

chinese: 我跑得比弟弟快。
pinyin: Wǒ pǎo de bǐ dìdi kuài.
english: I run faster than my younger brother.

chinese: 我是去年九月来中国的。
pinyin: Wǒ shì qùnián jiǔ yuè lái Zhōngguó de.
english: I came to China last September.

chinese: 我们是在北京认识的。
pinyin: Wǒmen shì zài Běijīng rènshi de.
english: We met in Beijing.

chinese: 他们是坐飞机去上海的。
pinyin: Tāmen shì zuò fēijī qù Shànghǎi de.
english: They flew to Shanghai.

chinese: 今天的晚饭是我做的。
pinyin: Jīntiān de wǎnfàn shì wǒ zuò de.
english: I cooked dinner tonight.

chinese: 妈妈叫我去超市买水果。
pinyin: Māma jiào wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi shuǐguǒ.
english: Mum asked me to go to the supermarket to buy some fruit.

chinese: 我想请老师教我中文。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng lǎoshī jiāo wǒ Zhōngwén.
english: I'd like to ask the teacher to teach me Chinese.

chinese: 老师让我们介绍一下自己的爱好。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen jièshào yíxià zìjǐ de àihào.
english: The teacher asked us to talk about our hobbies.

chinese: 爸爸送给我一个新手机。
pinyin: Bàba sònggěi wǒ yí ge xīn shǒujī.
english: Dad gave me a new mobile phone.

chinese: 他卖给我一本中文书。
pinyin: Tā màigěi wǒ yì běn Zhōngwén shū.
english: He sold me a book in Chinese.

chinese: 你（是）喝茶，还是喝咖啡？
pinyin: Nǐ (shì) hē chá, háishi hē kāfēi?
english: Do you prefer tea or coffee?

chinese: 你（是）喜欢白色的，还是黑色的？
pinyin: Nǐ (shì) xǐhuan báisè de, háishi hēisè de?
english: Do you prefer white or black?

chinese: 虽然学习的时间不长，但是他汉语说得很好。
pinyin: Suīrán xuéxí de shíjiān bù cháng, dànshì tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
english: Although he hasn't been studying for very long, his Mandarin is excellent.

chinese: 学汉语虽然难，但是很有意思。
pinyin: Xué Hànyǔ suīrán nán, dànshì hěn yǒuyìsi.
english: Learning Chinese is difficult, but it's great fun.

chinese: 因为机票太贵了，所以我准备坐火车去。
pinyin: Yīnwèi jīpiào tài guì le, suǒyǐ wǒ zhǔnbèi zuò huǒchē qù.
english: As the plane tickets are too expensive, I'm planning to go by train.

chinese: 因为我爸爸在中国工作，所以我来这儿学习中文。
pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ bàba zài Zhōngguó gōngzuò, suǒyǐ wǒ lái zhèr xuéxí Zhōngwén.
english: As my father works in China, I've come here to learn Chinese.

chinese: 他一下课就去打篮球了。
pinyin: Tā yí xià kè jiù qù dǎ lánqiú le.
english: He went to play basketball as soon as the lesson was over.

chinese: 我一到商场就想买东西。
pinyin: Wǒ yí dào shāngchǎng jiù xiǎng mǎi dōngxi.
english: As soon as I get to the shopping centre, I feel like buying something.

chinese: 门开着，你进去吧。
pinyin: Mén kāizhe, nǐ jìnqù ba.
english: The door's open; do come in.

chinese: 别站着，快请坐。
pinyin: Bié zhànzhe, kuài qǐng zuò.
english: Don't stand there; please take a seat.

chinese: 他们正吃着饭呢。
pinyin: Tāmen zhèng chīzhe fàn ne.
english: They were having their meal.

chinese: 教室里正上着课呢。
pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ zhèng shàngzhe kè ne.
english: A lesson is currently taking place in the classroom.

chinese: 你学过中文吗？
pinyin: Nǐ xuéguo Zhōngwén ma?
english: Have you ever learnt Chinese?

chinese: 我没去过北京。
pinyin: Wǒ méi qùguo Běijīng.
english: I've never been to Beijing.

chinese: 我的房间在三楼。
pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài sān lóu.
english: My room is on the third floor.

chinese: 你可以坐304路公交车。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zuò sān líng sì lù gōngjiāochē.
english: You can take the No. 304 bus.

chinese: 这几件衣服你帮我洗一下。
pinyin: Zhè jǐ jiàn yīfu nǐ bāng wǒ xǐ yíxià.
english: Could you wash these few items of clothing for me?

chinese: 我们学校有几百名外国学生。
pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào yǒu jǐbǎi míng wàiguó xuésheng.
english: Our school has several hundred international students.

chinese: 教室里有二十多个学生。
pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ yǒu èrshí duō ge xuésheng.
english: There are more than twenty pupils in the classroom.

chinese: 那个手机五千多块钱。
pinyin: Nàge shǒujī wǔqiān duō kuài qián.
english: That mobile phone costs over 5,000 yuan.

chinese: 我来中国已经三年多了。
pinyin: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó yǐjīng sān nián duō le.
english: I've been in China for over three years now.

chinese: 王老师的儿子今年六岁多了。
pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī de érzi jīnnián liù suì duō le.
english: Mr Wang's son is just over six years old this year.

chinese: 这家饭店的经理老李是我的朋友。
pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn de jīnglǐ Lǎo Lǐ shì wǒ de péngyou.
english: Mr Li, the manager of this restaurant, is a friend of mine.

chinese: 你听说过这个画家吗？
pinyin: Nǐ tīngshuōguo zhège huàjiā ma?
english: Have you ever heard of this painter?

chinese: 屋子有点儿小，可是很干净。
pinyin: Wūzi yǒudiǎnr xiǎo, kěshì hěn gānjìng.
english: The flat is a bit small, but it's very clean.

chinese: 她以前是一名羽毛球运动员。
pinyin: Tā yǐqián shì yì míng yǔmáoqiú yùndòngyuán.
english: She used to be a badminton player.

chinese: 我听说北方的冬天很冷。
pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō běifāng de dōngtiān hěn lěng.
english: I've heard that winters in the north are very cold.

chinese: 中国的北方和南方我都去过。
pinyin: Zhōngguó de běifāng hé nánfāng wǒ dōu qùguo.
english: I have been to both the north and the south of China.

chinese: 你们两个人中间的那个人是谁？
pinyin: Nǐmen liǎng ge rén zhōngjiān de nàge rén shì shéi?
english: Who is the person between the two of you?

chinese: 东方人和西方人的生活习惯不太一样。
pinyin: Dōngfāngrén hé xīfāngrén de shēnghuó xíguàn bú tài yíyàng.
english: The lifestyles of people in the East and the West are somewhat different.

chinese: 从这儿过去，大概需要多长时间？
pinyin: Cóng zhèr guòqù, dàgài xūyào duō cháng shíjiān?
english: How long does it take to get there from here?

chinese: 医生说我感冒了，需要吃药。
pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ gǎnmào le, xūyào chī yào.
english: The doctor said I've got a cold and need to take some medicine.

chinese: 已经十一点了，你该睡觉了。
pinyin: Yǐjīng shíyī diǎn le, nǐ gāi shuìjiào le.
english: It's already 11 o'clock; you should go to bed.

chinese: 你学了一天了，该休息休息了。
pinyin: Nǐ xuéle yì tiān le, gāi xiūxi xiūxi le.
english: You've been studying all day; it's time to have a rest.

chinese: 我们应该多练习说中文。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi duō liànxí shuō Zhōngwén.
english: We should practise speaking Chinese more often.

chinese: 我要去动物园，应该怎么坐车呢？
pinyin: Wǒ yào qù dòngwùyuán, yīnggāi zěnme zuò chē ne?
english: I'm going to the zoo. How should I get there?

chinese: 你愿意帮我学习汉语吗？
pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì bāng wǒ xuéxí Hànyǔ ma?
english: Would you be willing to help me learn Chinese?

chinese: 我很愿意参加这次汉语比赛。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn yuànyì cānjiā zhè cì Hànyǔ bǐsài.
english: I would very much like to take part in this Chinese language competition.

chinese: 要上课了，咱们得快点儿走。
pinyin: Yào shàng kè le, zánmen děi kuài diǎnr zǒu.
english: Class is about to start, so we'd better get a move on.

chinese: 我明天有考试，今天得认真复习。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, jīntiān děi rènzhēn fùxí.
english: I've got an exam tomorrow, so I need to revise properly today.

chinese: 我放了假就准备去旅游。
pinyin: Wǒ fàngle jià jiù zhǔnbèi qù lǚyóu.
english: As soon as I'm on holiday, I'm planning to go on a trip.

chinese: 我们已经很长时间没见过面了。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng hěn cháng shíjiān méi jiànguo miàn le.
english: It's been a long time since we last saw each other.

chinese: 结了婚以后，你还打算工作吗？
pinyin: Jiéle hūn yǐhòu, nǐ hái dǎsuàn gōngzuò ma?
english: Do you plan to carry on working after you get married?

chinese: 你先去洗个澡，休息一会儿。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù xǐ ge zǎo, xiūxi yíhuìr.
english: Why don't you have a shower first and have a rest for a while?

chinese: 我打不开这瓶水，你能帮帮我吗？
pinyin: Wǒ dǎbukāi zhè píng shuǐ, nǐ néng bāngbang wǒ ma?
english: I can't open this bottle of water. Could you give me a hand?

chinese: 黑板上的字你看得见吗？
pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng de zì nǐ kàndejiàn ma?
english: Can you see the writing on the blackboard?

chinese: 他已经离不开这个地方了。
pinyin: Tā yǐjīng líbukāi zhège dìfang le.
english: He has come to rely on this place.

chinese: 今天的作业我可能完不成了。
pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè wǒ kěnéng wánbuchéng le.
english: I don't think I'll be able to finish today's homework.

chinese: 我的中文越来越好，跟老师的帮助是分不开的。
pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén yuèláiyuè hǎo, gēn lǎoshī de bāngzhù shì fēnbukāi de.
english: My Chinese is getting better and better, and this is largely thanks to my teacher's help.

chinese: 怎样才能学好中文呢？
pinyin: Zěnyàng cái néng xuéhǎo Zhōngwén ne?
english: How can I learn Chinese effectively?

chinese: 他是怎样一个人？
pinyin: Tā shì zěnyàng yí ge rén?
english: What sort of person is he?

chinese: 这次旅行谁都可以参加。
pinyin: Zhè cì lǚxíng shéi dōu kěyǐ cānjiā.
english: Anyone is welcome to join this trip.

chinese: 我最近感冒了，哪儿都没去。
pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn gǎnmào le, nǎr dōu méi qù.
english: I've had a cold recently, so I haven't been anywhere.

chinese: 谁感兴趣谁就去参加。
pinyin: Shéi gǎn xìngqù shéi jiù qù cānjiā.
english: Anyone who's interested is welcome to take part.

chinese: 你想吃什么就点什么吧。
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme ba.
english: Just order whatever you fancy.

chinese: 我好像在哪儿见过她。
pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr jiànguo tā.
english: I feel as though I've seen her somewhere before.

chinese: 你先吃点儿什么再走吧。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān chī diǎnr shénme zài zǒu ba.
english: Why don't you have a bite to eat before you go?

chinese: 我下周搬家，想请谁来帮帮忙。
pinyin: Wǒ xià zhōu bānjiā, xiǎng qǐng shéi lái bāngbangmáng.
english: I'm moving house next week and I'd like to ask someone to give me a hand.

chinese: 咱们哪天一起去踢足球吧。
pinyin: Zánmen nǎ tiān yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba.
english: Let's go and play football together one of these days.

chinese: 我不太清楚，你问问别人吧。
pinyin: Wǒ bú tài qīngchu, nǐ wènwen biéren ba.
english: I'm not really sure; why don't you ask someone else?

chinese: 别人能学好，我也一定能学好。
pinyin: Biéren néng xuéhǎo, wǒ yě yídìng néng xuéhǎo.
english: If others can learn it well, I'm sure I can too.

chinese: 咱们明天一起去动物园，怎么样？
pinyin: Zánmen míngtiān yìqǐ qù dòngwùyuán, zěnmeyàng?
english: Shall we go to the zoo together tomorrow?

chinese: 要迟到了，咱们快走吧。
pinyin: Yào chídào le, zánmen kuài zǒu ba.
english: We're going to be late – let's get a move on.

chinese: 除了北京，你还去过别的城市吗？
pinyin: Chúle Běijīng, nǐ hái qùguo bié de chéngshì ma?
english: Apart from Beijing, have you been to any other cities?

chinese: 我喜欢学习别的国家的语言和文化。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan xuéxí bié de guójiā de yǔyán hé wénhuà.
english: I enjoy learning about the languages and cultures of other countries.

chinese: 其他同学都回国了，只有我还在中国。
pinyin: Qítā tóngxué dōu huí guó le, zhǐyǒu wǒ hái zài Zhōngguó.
english: All the other students have gone back to their home countries; I'm the only one still in China.

chinese: 除了看足球比赛，你还有其他爱好吗？
pinyin: Chúle kàn zúqiú bǐsài, nǐ hái yǒu qítā àihào ma?
english: Apart from watching football matches, do you have any other hobbies?

chinese: 下雨了，记得带一把伞。
pinyin: Xià yǔ le, jìde dài yì bǎ sǎn.
english: It's raining, so do remember to take an umbrella.

chinese: 我在网上买了两双鞋。
pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎngshàng mǎile liǎng shuāng xié.
english: I bought two pairs of shoes online.

chinese: 桌子上放着几张照片。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn.
english: There were a few photographs on the table.

chinese: 这里有多少种水果？
pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu duōshao zhǒng shuǐguǒ?
english: How many different types of fruit are there here?

chinese: 我们的教室在四层。
pinyin: Wǒmen de jiàoshì zài sì céng.
english: Our classroom is on the fourth floor.

chinese: 我想给我的爸爸妈妈写一封信。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi wǒ de bàba māma xiě yì fēng xìn.
english: I'd like to write a letter to my mum and dad.

chinese: 请大家打开书，第五页。
pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā dǎkāi shū, dì wǔ yè.
english: Please open your books to page five.

chinese: 那辆黑色的自行车是我的。
pinyin: Nà liàng hēisè de zìxíngchē shì wǒ de.
english: That black bicycle is mine.

chinese: 我每周都有一节中文课。
pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu dōu yǒu yì jié Zhōngwén kè.
english: I have one Chinese lesson every week.

chinese: 这个城市一共有三所大学。
pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yígòng yǒu sān suǒ dàxué.
english: There are three universities in this city.

chinese: 咱们坐下一班地铁走吧。
pinyin: Zánmen zuò xià yì bān dìtiě zǒu ba.
english: Let's take the next underground train.

chinese: 请大家用这些词写一段话。
pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā yòng zhèxiē cí xiě yí duàn huà.
english: Please use these words to write a short paragraph.

chinese: 爷爷家里养了十几头牛。
pinyin: Yéye jiā lǐ yǎngle shí jǐ tóu niú.
english: My grandfather keeps more than a dozen cows at his house.

chinese: 这句话是什么意思？
pinyin: Zhè jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
english: What does this sentence mean?

chinese: 苹果多少钱一斤/公斤？
pinyin: Píngguǒ duōshao qián yì jīn/gōngjīn?
english: How much do apples cost per jin or per kilogram?

chinese: 这些一共八块五角（毛）钱。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yígòng bā kuài wǔ jiǎo (máo) qián.
english: That comes to eight yuan fifty in all.

chinese: 现在八点一刻。
pinyin: Xiànzài bā diǎn yí kè.
english: It is now a quarter past eight.

chinese: 我哥哥身高一米八五。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge shēngāo yì mǐ bā wǔ.
english: My brother is 1.85 metres tall.

chinese: 我要一碗面条和一碗米饭。
pinyin: Wǒ yào yì wǎn miàntiáo hé yì wǎn mǐfàn.
english: I'd like a bowl of noodles and a bowl of rice.

chinese: 中午我在食堂吃了一盘饺子。
pinyin: Zhōngwǔ wǒ zài shítáng chīle yì pán jiǎozi.
english: At lunchtime, I had a plate of dumplings in the canteen.

chinese: 他喝了一口茶，然后开始工作。
pinyin: Tā hēle yì kǒu chá, ránhòu kāishǐ gōngzuò.
english: He took a sip of tea, then set to work.

chinese: 我已经说过好几回了，但他还是不记得。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng shuōguo hǎo jǐ huí le, dàn tā háishi bú jìde.
english: I've told him several times already, but he still can't seem to remember.

chinese: 对不起，我没听懂，请再说一遍。
pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ méi tīngdǒng, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
english: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat that, please?

chinese: 她跟我说了一声“谢谢”就走了。
pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ shuōle yì shēng "xièxie" jiù zǒu le.
english: She said ‘thank you' to me and then left.

chinese: 这些苹果个个都很大。
pinyin: Zhèxiē píngguǒ gègè dōu hěn dà.
english: These apples are all very large.

chinese: 他画的画，张张都很漂亮。
pinyin: Tā huà de huà, zhāngzhāng dōu hěn piàoliang.
english: Every single one of his paintings is beautiful.

chinese: 这本书的内容比较简单，我读得很快。
pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng bǐjiào jiǎndān, wǒ dú de hěn kuài.
english: The content of this book is fairly straightforward, so I read it quite quickly.

chinese: 外面太热了，屋子里还凉快一些。
pinyin: Wàimian tài rè le, wūzi lǐ hái liángkuai yìxiē.
english: It's too hot outside; it's a bit cooler indoors.

chinese: 搬家以后，我们的生活更方便了。
pinyin: Bānjiā yǐhòu, wǒmen de shēnghuó gèng fāngbiàn le.
english: Since moving house, our lives have become much more convenient.

chinese: 我弟弟特别喜欢看足球比赛。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi tèbié xǐhuan kàn zúqiú bǐsài.
english: My younger brother really loves watching football matches.

chinese: 多穿点儿衣服，外面挺冷的。
pinyin: Duō chuān diǎnr yīfu, wàimian tǐng lěng de.
english: Wrap up warm; it's quite cold outside.

chinese: 孩子这么晚还没回来，妈妈心里有些着急。
pinyin: Háizi zhème wǎn hái méi huílái, māma xīnli yǒuxiē zháojí.
english: The child hadn't come home yet, so Mum was starting to worry a little.

chinese: 冬天快要到了，天气越来越冷了。
pinyin: Dōngtiān kuàiyào dào le, tiānqì yuèláiyuè lěng le.
english: Winter is fast approaching, and the weather is getting colder and colder.

chinese: 我对中国历史极有兴趣。
pinyin: Wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ jí yǒu xìngqù.
english: I am extremely interested in Chinese history.

chinese: 他工作特别忙，周末极少休息。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò tèbié máng, zhōumò jí shǎo xiūxi.
english: He is extremely busy at work and rarely gets to rest at the weekend.

chinese: 我就要两斤苹果，不要别的。
pinyin: Wǒ jiù yào liǎng jīn píngguǒ, bú yào bié de.
english: I'd like two jin of apples, nothing else.

chinese: 办公室里就张老师一个人。
pinyin: Bàngōngshì lǐ jiù Zhāng lǎoshī yí ge rén.
english: Mr Zhang was the only person in the office.

chinese: 你跟我一块儿去图书馆，好吗？
pinyin: Nǐ gēn wǒ yíkuàir qù túshūguǎn, hǎo ma?
english: Would you like to come to the library with me?

chinese: 我们经常一块儿踢足球。
pinyin: Wǒmen jīngcháng yíkuàir tī zúqiú.
english: We often play football together.

chinese: 你们班一共有多少留学生？
pinyin: Nǐmen bān yígòng yǒu duōshao liúxuéshēng?
english: How many international students are there in your class?

chinese: 这些水果一共多少钱？
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ yígòng duōshao qián?
english: How much do these fruits cost in total?

chinese: 我只有一个哥哥，没有弟弟妹妹。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐyǒu yí ge gēge, méiyǒu dìdi mèimei.
english: I have only one older brother; I have no younger brothers or sisters.

chinese: 她只说了自己的名字，没说别的。
pinyin: Tā zhǐ shuōle zìjǐ de míngzi, méi shuō bié de.
english: She simply gave her name and said nothing else.

chinese: 公园里到处都是锻炼身体的老人。
pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ dàochù dōu shì duànliàn shēntǐ de lǎorén.
english: The park is full of elderly people doing exercise.

chinese: 她只是笑了笑，一句话也没说。
pinyin: Tā zhǐshì xiàole xiào, yí jù huà yě méi shuō.
english: She just smiled and didn't say a word.

chinese: 他才到家，还没有吃饭呢。
pinyin: Tā cái dào jiā, hái méiyǒu chī fàn ne.
english: He's only just got home; he hasn't had anything to eat yet.

chinese: 我才搬来北京，还不太习惯这里的生活
pinyin: Wǒ cái bānlái Běijīng, hái bú tài xíguàn zhèlǐ de shēnghuó
english: I've only just moved to Beijing, so I'm not quite used to life here yet.

chinese: 请等一下，我马上来。
pinyin: Qǐng děng yí xià, wǒ mǎshàng lái.
english: Please wait a moment; I'll be right there.

chinese: 接了电话，她马上就跑出去了。
pinyin: Jiēle diànhuà, tā mǎshàng jiù pǎochūqu le.
english: As soon as she answered the phone, she rushed out.

chinese: 你先走吧，我还有工作要做。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān zǒu ba, wǒ hái yǒu gōngzuò yào zuò.
english: You go on ahead; I've still got some work to do.

chinese: 我想先洗个澡，然后再写作业。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān xǐ ge zǎo, ránhòu zài xiě zuòyè.
english: I'd like to have a shower first, and then do my homework.

chinese: 最近天气变化很快，一会儿阴，一会儿晴。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, yíhuìr yīn, yíhuìr qíng.
english: The weather has been changing rapidly of late; one moment it's overcast, the next it's sunny.

chinese: 他刚开始学汉语，说得还不太好。
pinyin: Tā gāng kāishǐ xué Hànyǔ, shuō de hái bú tài hǎo.
english: He has only just started learning Chinese, so his Chinese isn't very good yet.

chinese: 报纸是早上刚送来的。
pinyin: Bàozhǐ shì zǎoshang gāng sònglái de.
english: The newspapers had just been delivered that morning.

chinese: 刚刚还是晴天，怎么突然下雨了？
pinyin: Gānggāng hái shì qíngtiān, zěnme tūrán xià yǔ le?
english: It was sunny just a moment ago – why has it suddenly started raining?

chinese: 他不在，刚刚出去。
pinyin: Tā bú zài, gānggāng chūqù.
english: He's not here; he's just gone out.

chinese: 我一直都住在北京。
pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí dōu zhù zài Běijīng.
english: I've always lived in Beijing.

chinese: 别出去了，外面一直在下雨。
pinyin: Bié chūqù le, wàimian yìzhí zài xià yǔ.
english: Don't go out; it's been raining all this time.

chinese: 一到冬天，孩子就总生病。
pinyin: Yí dào dōngtiān, háizi jiù zǒng shēngbìng.
english: As soon as winter arrives, the child is always falling ill.

chinese: 上学的时候，我总是让爸爸开车送我。
pinyin: Shàng xué de shíhou, wǒ zǒngshì ràng bàba kāi chē sòng wǒ.
english: When I was at school, my dad always used to drive me there.

chinese: 那个电影太有意思了，我昨天又看了一遍。
pinyin: Nàge diànyǐng tài yǒuyìsi le, wǒ zuótiān yòu kànle yí biàn.
english: That film was so entertaining; I watched it again yesterday.

chinese: 下课以后，我常常去体育馆打篮球。
pinyin: Xià kè yǐhòu, wǒ chángcháng qù tǐyùguǎn dǎ lánqiú.
english: After school, I often go to the sports hall to play basketball.

chinese: 孩子们高兴地一边唱歌一边跳舞。
pinyin: Háizimen gāoxìng de yìbiān chànggē yìbiān tiàowǔ.
english: The children were happily singing and dancing.

chinese: 我想找一个工作，一边工作一边学习。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yí ge gōngzuò, yìbiān gōngzuò yìbiān xuéxí.
english: I'd like to find a job so that I can work and study at the same time.

chinese: 他大概已经回家了。
pinyin: Tā dàgài yǐjīng huí jiā le.
english: He's probably gone home by now.

chinese: 你们学校大概有多少留学生？
pinyin: Nǐmen xuéxiào dàgài yǒu duōshao liúxuéshēng?
english: How many international students are there at your university, roughly?

chinese: 我必须做完才能下班。
pinyin: Wǒ bìxū zuòwán cái néng xià bān.
english: I have to finish this before I can leave work.

chinese: 老师要求我们必须每天复习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen bìxū měitiān fùxí.
english: The teacher has told us that we must revise every day.

chinese: 我学习中文差不多三年了。
pinyin: Wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén chàbuduō sān nián le.
english: I've been learning Chinese for nearly three years.

chinese: 我跟哥哥差不多高。
pinyin: Wǒ gēn gēge chàbuduō gāo.
english: I'm about the same height as my brother.

chinese: 放心，我一定不会迟到。
pinyin: Fàngxīn, wǒ yídìng bú huì chídào.
english: Don't worry, I certainly won't be late.

chinese: 我明天不一定有时间。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān bù yídìng yǒu shíjiān.
english: I'm not sure I'll be free tomorrow.

chinese: 她好像没有明白我的意思。
pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng méiyǒu míngbai wǒ de yìsi.
english: It seems she didn't quite understand what I meant.

chinese: 我好像在哪里见过她。
pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎlǐ jiànguo tā.
english: I feel as though I've seen her somewhere before.

chinese: 他几乎每天都去图书馆学习。
pinyin: Tā jīhū měitiān dōu qù túshūguǎn xuéxí.
english: He goes to the library to study almost every day.

chinese: 他太忙了，几乎没有时间休息。
pinyin: Tā tài máng le, jīhū méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
english: He is so busy that he hardly has any time to rest.

chinese: 我当然愿意帮助你。
pinyin: Wǒ dāngrán yuànyì bāngzhù nǐ.
english: Of course I'd be happy to help you.

chinese: 当然没问题，欢迎你参加。
pinyin: Dāngrán méi wèntí, huānyíng nǐ cānjiā.
english: Of course, no problem at all. You're very welcome to join us.

chinese: 这个问题其实不难。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí qíshí bù nán.
english: This question isn't actually that difficult.

chinese: 我以为他回国了，其实他一直在中国。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huí guó le, qíshí tā yìzhí zài Zhōngguó.
english: I thought he'd gone back to his home country, but in fact he's been in China all along.

chinese: 经过一年多的努力，工作终于完成了。
pinyin: Jīngguò yì nián duō de nǔlì, gōngzuò zhōngyú wánchéng le.
english: After more than a year's hard work, the task has finally been completed.

chinese: 考试终于都结束了，我太开心了。
pinyin: Kǎoshì zhōngyú dōu jiéshù le, wǒ tài kāixīn le.
english: The exams are finally over; I'm so happy.

chinese: 课文有点儿难，我读了三遍才明白。
pinyin: Kèwén yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ dúle sān biàn cái míngbai.
english: The text was a bit difficult; I had to read it three times before I understood it.

chinese: 这些旧书才卖了二十多块钱。
pinyin: Zhèxiē jiù shū cái màile èrshí duō kuài qián.
english: Those second-hand books only fetched a bit over twenty yuan.

chinese: 她今天六点半就起床了。
pinyin: Tā jīntiān liù diǎn bàn jiù qǐchuáng le.
english: She got up at half past six this morning.

chinese: 这个句子不难，我听一遍就懂了。
pinyin: Zhège jùzi bù nán, wǒ tīng yí biàn jiù dǒng le.
english: This sentence isn't difficult; I understood it after hearing it just once.

chinese: 你可以用手机买票，不必去车站，非常方便。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ yòng shǒujī mǎi piào, búbì qù chēzhàn, fēicháng fāngbiàn.
english: You can buy tickets on your mobile phone, so there's no need to go to the station – it's very convenient.

chinese: 不用担心，我们帮你一起准备。
pinyin: Búyòng dānxīn, wǒmen bāng nǐ yìqǐ zhǔnbèi.
english: Don't worry, we'll help you get everything ready.

chinese: 生日快乐，这是我为你做的蛋糕。
pinyin: Shēngrì kuàilè, zhè shì wǒ wèi nǐ zuò de dàngāo.
english: Happy birthday! Here's the cake I've made for you.

chinese: 大家为这次比赛做了很多准备。
pinyin: Dàjiā wèi zhè cì bǐsài zuòle hěn duō zhǔnbèi.
english: Everyone has put a great deal of effort into preparing for this competition.

chinese: 如果你不能去上课，应该向老师请假。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ bù néng qù shàng kè, yīnggāi xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjià.
english: If you are unable to attend a lesson, you should ask your teacher for permission to be absent.

chinese: 老师让我们向她学习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen xiàng tā xuéxí.
english: The teacher told us to follow her example.

chinese: 关于这个问题，我们还需要认真讨论。
pinyin: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒmen hái xūyào rènzhēn tǎolùn.
english: We still need to discuss this matter thoroughly.

chinese: 关于比赛的时间，我明天一定告诉大家。
pinyin: Guānyú bǐsài de shíjiān, wǒ míngtiān yídìng gàosu dàjiā.
english: I'll be sure to let you all know the time of the match tomorrow.

chinese: 他向门口走去，好像准备离开。
pinyin: Tā xiàng ménkǒu zǒuqù, hǎoxiàng zhǔnbèi líkāi.
english: He walked towards the door, as if he were about to leave.

chinese: 老师让大家看向前边。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng dàjiā kànxiàng qiánbian.
english: The teacher asked everyone to look ahead.

chinese: 为了身体健康，我们应该坚持锻炼。
pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, wǒmen yīnggāi jiānchí duànliàn.
english: For the sake of our health, we should keep up with our exercise.

chinese: 妈妈经常为了工作睡得很晚。
pinyin: Māma jīngcháng wèile gōngzuò shuì de hěn wǎn.
english: Mum often stays up late because of her work.

chinese: 大家都为我的好成绩感到高兴。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu wèi wǒ de hǎo chéngjì gǎndào gāoxìng.
english: Everyone was delighted with my good results.

chinese: 同学们都在为下个星期的考试做准备。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen dōu zài wèi xià ge xīngqī de kǎoshì zuò zhǔnbèi.
english: The students are all preparing for next week's exam.

chinese: 你把箱子放在这儿吧。
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ xiāngzi fàng zài zhèr ba.
english: Why don't you put the box here?

chinese: 我的自行车被朋友借走了。
pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi péngyou jièzǒu le.
english: A friend has borrowed my bike.

chinese: 大家可以根据兴趣选择自己喜欢的运动。
pinyin: Dàjiā kěyǐ gēnjù xìngqù xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de yùndòng.
english: You can choose whichever sport you like, depending on your interests.

chinese: 根据要求，我们必须参加明天的会议。
pinyin: Gēnjù yāoqiú, wǒmen bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì.
english: As requested, we must attend tomorrow's meeting.

chinese: 我喝茶或/或者咖啡都可以。
pinyin: Wǒ hē chá huò/huòzhě kāfēi dōu kěyǐ.
english: I'm happy with either tea or coffee.

chinese: 我们可以打车或/或者坐地铁去。
pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ dǎ chē huò/huòzhě zuò dìtiě qù.
english: We can take a taxi or the underground.

chinese: 只有大家一起想办法，才能解决这个问题。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu dàjiā yìqǐ xiǎng bànfǎ, cái néng jiějué zhège wèntí.
english: Only by working together to find a solution can we resolve this issue.

chinese: 只要你想学，就一定能学好。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ xiǎng xué, jiù yídìng néng xuéhǎo.
english: As long as you're willing to learn, you're bound to do well.

chinese: 我不但学习了中文，而且认识了很多新朋友。
pinyin: Wǒ búdàn xuéxíle Zhōngwén, érqiě rènshile hěn duō xīn péngyou.
english: Not only have I learnt Chinese, but I've also made lots of new friends.

chinese: 如果你有时间，我想请你参加我的生日晚会。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ cānjiā wǒ de shēngrì wǎnhuì.
english: If you've got time, I'd like to invite you to my birthday party.

chinese: 她特别想来中国看看，可一直没有合适的机会。
pinyin: Tā tèbié xiǎng lái Zhōngguó kànkan, kě yìzhí méiyǒu héshì de jīhuì.
english: She's been really keen to visit China, but hasn't had the right opportunity yet.

chinese: 我很早就到了机场，可是没想到飞机晚点了。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn zǎo jiù dàole jīchǎng, kěshì méi xiǎngdào fēijī wǎndiǎn le.
english: I arrived at the airport quite early, but I didn't expect the flight to be delayed.

chinese: 你先去那边买票，然后过来找我。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù nàbian mǎi piào, ránhòu guòlái zhǎo wǒ.
english: Go over there and buy your ticket first, then come and find me.

chinese: 你喜欢的话，就送给你吧。
pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan dehuà, jiù sònggěi nǐ ba.
english: If you like it, I'll give it to you.

chinese: 如果明天下雨的话，我们就不去爬山了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ dehuà, wǒmen jiù bú qù páshān le.
english: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

chinese: 首都北京、她一个人、我们学生
pinyin: Shǒudū Běijīng, tā yí ge rén, wǒmen xuésheng
english: Beijing, the capital; her, all on her own; us students

chinese: 漂亮极了、累坏了、看不懂、写得完
pinyin: Piàoliang jíle, lèihuài le, kànbudǒng, xiědewán
english: Absolutely lovely, utterly exhausted, can't make head nor tail of it, I'll manage to finish writing it

chinese: 工作要一步一步地做。
pinyin: Gōngzuò yào yí bù yí bù de zuò.
english: Work should be done one step at a time.

chinese: 老师一句一句地教我们读课文。
pinyin: Lǎoshī yí jù yí jù de jiāo wǒmen dú kèwén.
english: The teacher taught us to read the text, one sentence at a time.

chinese: 这件衣服不大不小，特别合适。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú dà bù xiǎo, tèbié héshì.
english: This top isn't too big or too small; it fits perfectly.

chinese: 最近天气不冷不热，很舒服。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bù lěng bú rè, hěn shūfu.
english: The weather's been neither too cold nor too hot of late; it's very pleasant.

chinese: 不一会儿，张校长就来了。
pinyin: Bù yíhuìr, Zhāng xiàozhǎng jiù lái le.
english: It wasn't long before Headteacher Zhang arrived.

chinese: 时间不一会儿就过去了。
pinyin: Shíjiān bù yíhuìr jiù guòqù le.
english: Time flew by in no time at all.

chinese: 电梯坏了，看来咱们只能走楼梯了。
pinyin: Diàntī huài le, kànlái zánmen zhǐ néng zǒu lóutī le.
english: The lift's out of order, so it looks like we'll have to take the stairs.

chinese: 这么晚了，看来他今天不会来了。
pinyin: Zhème wǎn le, kànlái tā jīntiān bú huì lái le.
english: It's so late; it looks as though he won't be coming today.

chinese: 在同事们看来，她对工作非常认真。
pinyin: Zài tóngshìmen kànlái, tā duì gōngzuò fēicháng rènzhēn.
english: In the eyes of her colleagues, she takes her work very seriously.

chinese: 在我看来，坚持读书是一种很好的习惯。
pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, jiānchí dúshū shì yì zhǒng hěn hǎo de xíguàn.
english: In my view, making a habit of reading is a very good habit.

chinese: 听说学习中文的年轻人越来越多。
pinyin: Tīngshuō xuéxí Zhōngwén de niánqīngrén yuèláiyuè duō.
english: I've heard that more and more young people are learning Chinese.

chinese: 我越来越习惯这里的生活了。
pinyin: Wǒ yuèláiyuè xíguàn zhèlǐ de shēnghuó le.
english: I'm getting more and more used to life here.

chinese: 这些菜看起来都很好吃。
pinyin: Zhèxiē cài kànqǐlai dōu hěn hǎochī.
english: These dishes all look delicious.

chinese: 那个新来的老师看起来很年轻。
pinyin: Nàge xīn lái de lǎoshī kànqǐlai hěn niánqīng.
english: That new teacher looks very young.

chinese: 这道题看上去很难，其实很简单。
pinyin: Zhè dào tí kànshàngqu hěn nán, qíshí hěn jiǎndān.
english: This question looks difficult, but it's actually quite simple.

chinese: 她看上去不像五十多岁的人。
pinyin: Tā kànshàngqu bú xiàng wǔshí duō suì de rén.
english: She doesn't look like someone in her fifties.

chinese: 一般来说，早上锻炼身体比较好。
pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, zǎoshang duànliàn shēntǐ bǐjiào hǎo.
english: Generally speaking, it is better to exercise in the morning.

chinese: 一般来说，学习外语需要多练习。
pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, xuéxí wàiyǔ xūyào duō liànxí.
english: Generally speaking, learning a foreign language requires plenty of practice.

chinese: 我觉得这些照片照得不怎么样。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèxiē zhàopiàn zhào de bù zěnmeyàng.
english: I don't think these photos are very good.

chinese: 虽然考试前我复习了很长时间，但是成绩不怎么样。
pinyin: Suīrán kǎoshì qián wǒ fùxíle hěn cháng shíjiān, dànshì chéngjì bù zěnmeyàng.
english: Although I spent a long time revising before the exam, my results weren't great.

chinese: 除了看新闻（以外），人们还/也可以在网上看电影、买东西。
pinyin: Chúle kàn xīnwén (yǐwài), rénmen hái/yě kěyǐ zài wǎngshàng kàn diànyǐng, mǎi dōngxi.
english: As well as reading the news, people can also watch films and shop online.

chinese: 除了北京（以外），别的城市我都没去过。
pinyin: Chúle Běijīng (yǐwài), bié de chéngshì wǒ dōu méi qùguo.
english: Apart from Beijing, I haven't been to any other cities.

chinese: 从那天起，我们就变成了好朋友。
pinyin: Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒmen jiù biànchéngle hǎo péngyou.
english: From that day on, we became good friends.

chinese: 从现在起，我一定要努力学习。
pinyin: Cóng xiànzài qǐ, wǒ yídìng yào nǔlì xuéxí.
english: From now on, I'm determined to study hard.

chinese: 对他来说，这个机会非常重要。
pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, zhège jīhuì fēicháng zhòngyào.
english: For him, this opportunity is very important.

chinese: 对我来说，学习汉语很有意思。
pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xuéxí Hànyǔ hěn yǒuyìsi.
english: For me, learning Chinese is great fun.

chinese: 来中国以前，我一句汉语也不会说。
pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó yǐqián, wǒ yí jù Hànyǔ yě bú huì shuō.
english: Before I came to China, I couldn't speak a word of Chinese.

chinese: 你说的这些地方我一个都没去过。
pinyin: Nǐ shuō de zhèxiē dìfang wǒ yí ge dōu méi qùguo.
english: I haven't been to any of the places you've mentioned.

chinese: 快要考试了，你怎么一点儿也不着急？
pinyin: Kuàiyào kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme yìdiǎnr yě bù zháojí?
english: The exams are coming up soon – why aren't you the slightest bit worried?

chinese: 今天天气很好，一点儿也不冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo, yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng.
english: The weather is lovely today; it's not cold at all.

chinese: 我想认识中国朋友，越多越好。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng rènshi Zhōngguó péngyou, yuè duō yuè hǎo.
english: I'd like to make friends from China – the more, the better.

chinese: 医生让我多休息，休息得越多，好得越快。
pinyin: Yīshēng ràng wǒ duō xiūxi, xiūxi de yuè duō, hǎo de yuè kuài.
english: The doctor told me to get plenty of rest; the more rest I get, the quicker I'll recover.

chinese: 考试以前，你一定要认真复习。
pinyin: Kǎoshì yǐqián, nǐ yídìng yào rènzhēn fùxí.
english: Before the exam, you must revise thoroughly.

chinese: 来到中国以后，我慢慢习惯了这里的生活。
pinyin: Láidào Zhōngguó yǐhòu, wǒ mànmàn xíguànle zhèlǐ de shēnghuó.
english: Since arriving in China, I have gradually got used to life here.

chinese: 睡觉前别忘记吃药。
pinyin: Shuìjiào qián bié wàngjì chī yào.
english: Don't forget to take your medicine before going to bed.

chinese: 放学后，我要参加留学生篮球比赛。
pinyin: Fàng xué hòu, wǒ yào cānjiā liúxuéshēng lánqiú bǐsài.
english: After school, I'm going to take part in a basketball tournament for international students.

chinese: 在离开中国以前，我一定要去长城看看。
pinyin: Zài líkāi Zhōngguó yǐqián, wǒ yídìng yào qù Chángchéng kànkan.
english: Before I leave China, I simply must go and see the Great Wall.

chinese: 难过什么啊，你的成绩不是挺好的吗？
pinyin: Nánguò shénme a, nǐ de chéngjì bú shì tǐng hǎo de ma?
english: Why are you so upset? Aren't your marks quite good?

chinese: 方便什么啊，附近一个超市都没有。
pinyin: Fāngbiàn shénme a, fùjìn yí ge chāoshì dōu méiyǒu.
english: What's so convenient about that? There isn't a single supermarket nearby.

chinese: 八点了，该上课了。
pinyin: Bā diǎn le, gāi shàng kè le.
english: It's eight o'clock; it's time for the lesson to start.

chinese: 下周要考试，我该复习了。
pinyin: Xià zhōu yào kǎoshì, wǒ gāi fùxí le.
english: I've got an exam next week, so I'd better start revising.

chinese: 在学习上，老师和同学给了我许多帮助。
pinyin: Zài xuéxí shàng, lǎoshī hé tóngxué gěile wǒ xǔduō bāngzhù.
english: When it comes to my studies, my teachers and classmates have been a great help to me.

chinese: 在父母的影响下，我从小就对中文很感兴趣。
pinyin: Zài fùmǔ de yǐngxiǎng xià, wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù duì Zhōngwén hěn gǎn xìngqù.
english: Thanks to my parents' influence, I have been interested in the Chinese language since I was a child.

chinese: 在这次比赛中，我认识了一些新朋友。
pinyin: Zài zhè cì bǐsài zhōng, wǒ rènshile yìxiē xīn péngyou.
english: I made some new friends at this competition.

chinese: 哭没有用。
pinyin: Kū méiyǒu yòng.
english: There's no point in crying.

chinese: 多穿一点儿比较好。
pinyin: Duō chuān yìdiǎnr bǐjiào hǎo.
english: It's best to wear a bit more.

chinese: 太胖了不好，太瘦了也不好。
pinyin: Tài pàng le bù hǎo, tài shòu le yě bù hǎo.
english: It's not good to be too fat, nor is it good to be too thin.

chinese: 你来也可以。
pinyin: Nǐ lái yě kěyǐ.
english: You're welcome to come along too.

chinese: 身体健康最重要。
pinyin: Shēntǐ jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào.
english: Good health is the most important thing.

chinese: 我昨天新买的那条黑色的裤子你放在哪儿了？
pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān xīn mǎi de nà tiáo hēisè de kùzi nǐ fàng zài nǎr le?
english: Where did you put those black trousers I bought yesterday?

chinese: 前面那个穿着蓝衬衫的短头发高个子的老人就是我的中文老师。
pinyin: Qiánmian nàge chuānzhe lán chènshān de duǎn tóufa gāo gèzi de lǎorén jiùshì wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī.
english: That tall, short-haired elderly man in the blue shirt at the front is my Chinese teacher.

chinese: 火车票你买到了没有？
pinyin: Huǒchēpiào nǐ mǎidào le méiyǒu?
english: Have you managed to get your train ticket yet?

chinese: 老师说的话我都记住了。
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de huà wǒ dōu jìzhù le.
english: I've taken note of everything the teacher said.

chinese: 我的自行车让朋友骑走了。
pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē ràng péngyou qízǒu le.
english: A friend took my bike for a ride.

chinese: 下班的时候，别忘了关上电脑。
pinyin: Xià bān de shíhou, bié wàngle guānshàng diànnǎo.
english: When you finish work, don't forget to switch off your computer.

chinese: 我们终于想出了一个好办法。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhōngyú xiǎngchūle yí ge hǎo bànfǎ.
english: We've finally come up with a good solution.

chinese: 你想起她的名字了没有？
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngqǐ tā de míngzi le méiyǒu?
english: Have you remembered her name yet?

chinese: 请在这儿写下您的电话。
pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèr xiěxià nín de diànhuà.
english: Please enter your telephone number here.

chinese: 饿了一天，我们终于吃上饭了。
pinyin: Èle yì tiān, wǒmen zhōngyú chīshàng fàn le.
english: After going without food all day, we finally got something to eat.

chinese: 儿子刚到家就玩上了电脑游戏。
pinyin: Érzi gāng dào jiā jiù wánshàngle diànnǎo yóuxì.
english: As soon as my son got home, he started playing computer games.

chinese: 他们一见面就聊起来了。
pinyin: Tāmen yí jiànmiàn jiù liáo qǐlái le.
english: They started chatting as soon as they met.

chinese: 妈妈一出门，孩子就哭起来了。
pinyin: Māma yì chūmén, háizi jiù kūqǐlai le.
english: As soon as Mum went out, the child started crying.

chinese: 虽然学习汉语不容易，但是我一定会坚持下去。
pinyin: Suīrán xuéxí Hànyǔ bù róngyì, dànshì wǒ yídìng huì jiānchíxiàqu.
english: Although learning Chinese isn't easy, I'm determined to stick with it.

chinese: 在老师的帮助下，我一定可以学下去。
pinyin: Zài lǎoshī de bāngzhù xià, wǒ yídìng kěyǐ xuéxiàqu.
english: With the teacher's help, I'm sure I'll be able to carry on with my studies.

chinese: 在过去的一年里，我把每天练习汉字的习惯坚持下来了。
pinyin: Zài guòqù de yì nián lǐ, wǒ bǎ měitiān liànxí Hànzì de xíguàn jiānchíxiàlai le.
english: Over the past year, I have managed to stick to my daily habit of practising Chinese characters.

chinese: 这三天玩下来太累了，我得好好休息休息。
pinyin: Zhè sān tiān wánxiàlai tài lèi le, wǒ děi hǎohǎo xiūxi xiūxi.
english: These last three days have been so tiring; I really need to have a proper rest.

chinese: 老师说的话你听得懂吗？
pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō de huà nǐ tīng de dǒng ma?
english: Do you understand what the teacher is saying?

chinese: 黑板上的字太小，我看不清楚。
pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng de zì tài xiǎo, wǒ kàn bu qīngchu.
english: The writing on the blackboard is too small; I can't make it out.

chinese: 这里的环境好得很。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng hǎo de hěn.
english: The surroundings here are absolutely lovely.

chinese: 这儿从早到晚都有风，凉快得很。
pinyin: Zhèr cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu yǒu fēng, liángkuai de hěn.
english: It's very breezy here from morning till night, and it's lovely and cool.

chinese: 看见考试成绩的时候，我高兴极了。
pinyin: Kànjiàn kǎoshì chéngjì de shíhou, wǒ gāoxìng jíle.
english: When I saw my exam results, I was absolutely delighted.

chinese: 爬山回来，大家都累坏了。
pinyin: Páshān huílái, dàjiā dōu lèihuài le.
english: After coming back from the hike, everyone was absolutely knackered.

chinese: 开学已经两个星期了。
pinyin: Kāixué yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqī le.
english: It's been two weeks since the start of term.

chinese: 这件事已经过去五年了。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng guòqù wǔ nián le.
english: It has been five years since that happened.

chinese: 怎样才能学好汉语呢？
pinyin: Zěnyàng cái néng xuéhǎo Hànyǔ ne?
english: How can I learn Chinese effectively?

chinese: 中国人是怎样过新年的？
pinyin: Zhōngguórén shì zěnyàng guò xīnnián de?
english: How do the Chinese celebrate the New Year?

chinese: 你不是写完作业了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xiěwán zuòyè le ma?
english: Haven't you finished your homework?

chinese: 考试不是下个星期一吗？
pinyin: Kǎoshì bú shì xià ge xīngqīyī ma?
english: Isn't the exam next Monday?

chinese: 你把箱子放在这儿吧。
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ xiāngzi fàng zài zhèr ba.
english: Why don't you put the box here?

chinese: 我们把桌子搬到教室外边了。
pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ zhuōzi bāndào jiàoshì wàibian le.
english: We've moved the tables outside the classroom.

chinese: 我们把礼物送给老师了。
pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ lǐwù sònggěi lǎoshī le.
english: We gave the presents to our teacher.

chinese: 他把那本书借给我了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ nà běn shū jiègěi wǒ le.
english: He lent me that book.

chinese: 我已经把晚饭准备好了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ wǎnfàn zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
english: I've already prepared dinner.

chinese: 咱们把这些桌子搬进去吧。
pinyin: Zánmen bǎ zhèxiē zhuōzi bānjìnqu ba.
english: Let's carry these tables inside.

chinese: 妈妈把衣服洗得干干净净。
pinyin: Māma bǎ yīfu xǐ de gāngānjìngjìng.
english: Mum washed the clothes until they were spotlessly clean.

chinese: 我的词典被朋友借走了。
pinyin: Wǒ de cídiǎn bèi péngyou jièzǒu le.
english: A friend has borrowed my dictionary.

chinese: 冰箱里的水果被谁吃了？
pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de shuǐguǒ bèi shéi chī le?
english: Who ate the fruit in the fridge?

chinese: 桌子上的作业被拿走了。
pinyin: Zhuōzi shàng de zuòyè bèi názǒu le.
english: The homework on the table was taken away.

chinese: 病人已经被送到医院了。
pinyin: Bìngrén yǐjīng bèi sòngdào yīyuàn le.
english: The patient has already been taken to hospital.

chinese: 老师总是笑着回答大家的问题。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zǒngshì xiàozhe huídá dàjiā de wèntí.
english: The teacher always answers everyone's questions with a smile.

chinese: 我喜欢听着音乐做运动。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan tīngzhe yīnyuè zuò yùndòng.
english: I like to exercise whilst listening to music.

chinese: 她的汉语比我更好。
pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo.
english: Her Chinese is better than mine.

chinese: 今天比昨天还冷。
pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān hái lěng.
english: It's colder today than it was yesterday.

chinese: 我的爱好跟他一样。
pinyin: Wǒ de àihào gēn tā yíyàng.
english: My hobbies are the same as his.

chinese: 他买的新手机跟我的一样。
pinyin: Tā mǎi de xīn shǒujī gēn wǒ de yíyàng.
english: The new mobile phone he bought is the same as mine.

chinese: 坐地铁跟坐公交车一样方便。
pinyin: Zuò dìtiě gēn zuò gōngjiāochē yíyàng fāngbiàn.
english: Travelling by underground is just as convenient as travelling by bus.

chinese: 这个房间跟那个房间一样大。
pinyin: Zhège fángjiān gēn nàge fángjiān yíyàng dà.
english: This room is the same size as that one.

chinese: 这张画不比那张好看。
pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà bù bǐ nà zhāng hǎokàn.
english: This painting isn't any better than that one.

chinese: 我的汉语水平不比他高。
pinyin: Wǒ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng bù bǐ tā gāo.
english: My Chinese isn't any better than his.

chinese: 我比他早到十分钟。
pinyin: Wǒ bǐ tā zǎo dào shí fēnzhōng.
english: I arrived ten minutes before him.

chinese: 哥哥比弟弟多吃了三个饺子。
pinyin: Gēge bǐ dìdi duō chīle sān ge jiǎozi.
english: The older brother ate three more dumplings than his younger brother.

chinese: 前边开过来一辆出租车。
pinyin: Qiánbian kāiguòlai yí liàng chūzūchē.
english: A taxi came driving up from ahead.

chinese: 楼上搬来了一家人。
pinyin: Lóushàng bānláile yì jiā rén.
english: A family has moved into the flat upstairs.

chinese: 校门外走进来几个学生。
pinyin: Xiàomén wài zǒujìnlai jǐ ge xuésheng.
english: A few pupils walked in through the school gates.

chinese: 树上飞走了三只小鸟。
pinyin: Shùshang fēizǒule sān zhī xiǎoniǎo.
english: Three little birds flew away from the tree.

chinese: 他家里跑丢了一只羊。
pinyin: Tā jiā lǐ pǎodiūle yì zhī yáng.
english: A sheep went missing from his farm.

chinese: 这个问题其实是很简单的。
pinyin: Zhège wèntí qíshí shì hěn jiǎndān de.
english: This question is actually quite simple.

chinese: 多写多练对学习汉字是很有帮助的。
pinyin: Duō xiě duō liàn duì xuéxí Hànzì shì hěn yǒu bāngzhù de.
english: Writing and practising as much as possible is very helpful when learning Chinese characters.

chinese: 我们昨天打篮球打了一个下午。
pinyin: Wǒmen zuótiān dǎ lánqiú dǎle yí ge xiàwǔ.
english: We spent the whole afternoon playing basketball yesterday.

chinese: 你今天上课上得怎么样？
pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān shàng kè shàng de zěnmeyàng?
english: How did your lessons go today?

chinese: 你先去买门票，再来这里找我。
pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù mǎi ménpiào, zài lái zhèlǐ zhǎo wǒ.
english: Go and buy your ticket first, then come back here to find me.

chinese: 我想先吃饭，然后回房间休息。
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān chī fàn, ránhòu huí fángjiān xiūxi.
english: I'd like to have dinner first, then go back to my room to rest.

chinese: 每周末，我们或者踢足球，或者打篮球。
pinyin: Měi zhōumò, wǒmen huòzhě tī zúqiú, huòzhě dǎ lánqiú.
english: Every weekend, we either play football or basketball.

chinese: 春节的时候，人们或者回家过节，或者出门旅游。
pinyin: Chūn Jié de shíhou, rénmen huòzhě huí jiā guò jié, huòzhě chūmén lǚyóu.
english: During the Spring Festival, people either return home to celebrate or go on holiday.

chinese: 他一会儿进来，一会儿出去，忙得很。
pinyin: Tā yíhuìr jìnlái, yíhuìr chūqù, máng de hěn.
english: He was constantly popping in and out; he was very busy.

chinese: 最近的天气一会儿冷，一会儿热。
pinyin: Zuìjìn de tiānqì yíhuìr lěng, yíhuìr rè.
english: The weather has been rather changeable of late, alternating between cold and warm.

chinese: 这件衣服又便宜又好看。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu yòu piányi yòu hǎokàn.
english: This top is both cheap and stylish.

chinese: 那个又高又漂亮的女孩儿是谁？
pinyin: Nàge yòu gāo yòu piàoliang de nǚháir shì shéi?
english: Who is that tall, pretty girl?

chinese: 他一边工作，一边学习中文。
pinyin: Tā yìbiān gōngzuò, yìbiān xuéxí Zhōngwén.
english: He works whilst learning Chinese.

chinese: 我喜欢一边跑步，一边听音乐。
pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yìbiān pǎobù, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè.
english: I like listening to music whilst I'm out for a run.

chinese: 不但我学习中文，而且我的弟弟也学习中文。
pinyin: Búdàn wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén, érqiě wǒ de dìdi yě xuéxí Zhōngwén.
english: Not only am I learning Chinese, but my younger brother is learning Chinese too.

chinese: 我哥哥不但会打篮球，而且打得很好。
pinyin: Wǒ gēge búdàn huì dǎ lánqiú, érqiě dǎ de hěn hǎo.
english: My brother not only plays basketball, but he's very good at it.

chinese: 房间虽然不大，可是很干净。
pinyin: Fángjiān suīrán bú dà, kěshì hěn gānjìng.
english: Although the room isn't very big, it's very clean.

chinese: 虽然天气很冷，可是他还是坚持每天锻炼。
pinyin: Suīrán tiānqì hěn lěng, kěshì tā háishi jiānchí měitiān duànliàn.
english: Although it's very cold, he still makes a point of exercising every day.

chinese: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
english: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go for a walk in the hills.

chinese: 如果你需要帮忙，就给我打电话。
pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xūyào bāngmáng, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
english: If you need any help, just give me a call.

chinese: 你有时间的话，就一起去吧。
pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shíjiān dehuà, jiù yìqǐ qù ba.
english: If you've got time, why not come along?

chinese: 你觉得满意的话，咱们就买。
pinyin: Nǐ juéde mǎnyì dehuà, zánmen jiù mǎi.
english: If you're happy with it, we'll buy it.

chinese: 只有努力学习，才能得到好成绩。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǔlì xuéxí, cái néng dédào hǎo chéngjì.
english: Only by studying hard can you achieve good results.

chinese: 只有多听、多说、多看，你的中文水平才能提高。
pinyin: Zhǐyǒu duō tīng, duō shuō, duō kàn, nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng cái néng tígāo.
english: Only by listening, speaking and reading more will your Chinese improve.

chinese: 只要你坚持学习，就一定能学好。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí xuéxí, jiù yídìng néng xuéhǎo.
english: As long as you keep at it, you're bound to do well.

chinese: 只要你同意，我们就这么决定了。
pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème juédìng le.
english: As long as you agree, that's what we'll do.

chinese: 为了考上大学，她每天努力学习。
pinyin: Wèile kǎoshàng dàxué, tā měitiān nǔlì xuéxí.
english: She studies hard every day in order to get into university.

chinese: 为了早点儿到家，我打算坐飞机。
pinyin: Wèile zǎodiǎnr dào jiā, wǒ dǎsuàn zuò fēijī.
english: To get home earlier, I'm planning to fly.

chinese: 他吃了药就好多了。
pinyin: Tā chīle yào jiù hǎo duō le.
english: He felt much better after taking the medicine.

chinese: 我打算下了课就去图书馆。
pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn xiàle kè jiù qù túshūguǎn.
english: I'm planning to go to the library after class.

chinese: 你大概多长时间能到？
pinyin: Nǐ dàgài duō cháng shíjiān néng dào?
english: How long will it take you to get here, roughly?

chinese: 这些水果大概五十块钱。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ dàgài wǔshí kuài qián.
english: These fruits cost about fifty yuan.

chinese: 教室里来了七八个学生。
pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ láile qī bā ge xuésheng.
english: Seven or eight pupils came into the classroom.

chinese: 从我家到学校，走路需要十五六分钟。
pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào xuéxiào, zǒulù xūyào shíwǔ liù fēnzhōng.
english: It takes about fifteen or sixteen minutes to walk from my house to school.

chinese: 我刚学会开车，不敢开得很快。
pinyin: Wǒ gāng xuéhuì kāi chē, bù gǎn kāi de hěn kuài.
english: I've only just learnt to drive, so I don't dare drive too fast.

chinese: 你敢不敢跟我比一比，谁的力气大？
pinyin: Nǐ gǎn bu gǎn gēn wǒ bǐ yi bǐ, shéi de lìqi dà?
english: Do you dare have a go at me to see who's stronger?

chinese: 对于这个问题，同学们各有各的看法。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège wèntí, tóngxuémen gè yǒu gè de kànfǎ.
english: Students have their own views on this issue.

chinese: 节日期间，各地举行了丰富的庆祝活动。
pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, gèdì jǔxíngle fēngfù de qìngzhù huódòng.
english: During the festive period, a wide range of celebratory events were held across the country.

chinese: 各位同学，请大家安静一下。
pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué, qǐng dàjiā ānjìng yíxià.
english: Ladies and gentlemen, please be quiet.

chinese: 欢迎各位报名参加这次运动会。
pinyin: Huānyíng gèwèi bàomíng cānjiā zhè cì yùndònghuì.
english: We invite everyone to sign up for this sports day.

chinese: 南方各种花都开了，可是北方还比较冷。
pinyin: Nánfāng gèzhǒng huā dōu kāi le, kěshì běifāng hái bǐjiào lěng.
english: All sorts of flowers are in bloom in the south, but it's still quite cold in the north.

chinese: 商场、超市总是通过各种方式吸引顾客。
pinyin: Shāngchǎng, chāoshì zǒngshì tōngguò gèzhǒng fāngshì xīyǐn gùkè.
english: Shopping centres and supermarkets are always finding various ways to attract customers.

chinese: 你遇到任何困难都可以联系我。
pinyin: Nǐ yùdào rènhé kùnnan dōu kěyǐ liánxì wǒ.
english: Please feel free to contact me if you encounter any difficulties.

chinese: 在中国，几乎任何一家商店都可以使用手机支付。
pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, jīhū rènhé yì jiā shāngdiàn dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng shǒujī zhīfù.
english: In China, mobile payments are accepted in almost any shop.

chinese: 此处不能扔垃圾，请扔到垃圾桶里。
pinyin: Cǐchù bù néng rēng lājī, qǐng rēngdào lājītǒng lǐ.
english: Please do not leave rubbish here; please put it in the bin.

chinese: 对于此事，你的父母有什么意见？
pinyin: Duìyú cǐ shì, nǐ de fùmǔ yǒu shénme yìjiàn?
english: What do your parents think about this?

chinese: 昨晚老张买了一打啤酒。
pinyin: Zuówǎn Lǎo Zhāng mǎile yì dǎ píjiǔ.
english: Last night, Old Zhang bought a dozen beers.

chinese: 我买了一打鸡蛋，准备做蛋糕。
pinyin: Wǒ mǎile yì dǎ jīdàn, zhǔnbèi zuò dàngāo.
english: I bought a dozen eggs to make a cake.

chinese: 我这儿有一袋方便面，你要不要吃？
pinyin: Wǒ zhèr yǒu yí dài fāngbiànmiàn, nǐ yào bu yào chī?
english: I've got a packet of instant noodles here. Fancy some?

chinese: 妈妈从市场买回来好几袋水果。
pinyin: Māma cóng shìchǎng mǎihuílai hǎo jǐ dài shuǐguǒ.
english: Mum came home from the market with several bags of fruit.

chinese: 我家院子里种着两棵苹果树。
pinyin: Wǒ jiā yuànzi lǐ zhòngzhe liǎng kē píngguǒshù.
english: There are two apple trees growing in my garden.

chinese: 小猫爬上了路边的一棵大树。
pinyin: Xiǎo māo páshàngle lùbiān de yì kē dà shù.
english: The kitten climbed up a large tree by the roadside.

chinese: 这台空调太旧了，没办法修。
pinyin: Zhè tái kōngtiáo tài jiù le, méi bànfǎ xiū.
english: This air-conditioner is far too old; it can't be repaired.

chinese: 搬家时，我把家里那台冰箱卖了。
pinyin: Bānjiā shí, wǒ bǎ jiā lǐ nà tái bīngxiāng mài le.
english: When I moved house, I sold our fridge.

chinese: 您能介绍一下这幅画吗？
pinyin: Nín néng jièshào yíxià zhè fú huà ma?
english: Could you tell us a bit about this painting?

chinese: 张老师，我想请您给我写一幅字。
pinyin: Zhāng lǎoshī, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nín gěi wǒ xiě yì fú zì.
english: Mr Zhang, I would like to ask you to write a piece of calligraphy for me.

chinese: 她拿着礼物，一脸兴奋地跑了进来。
pinyin: Tā názhe lǐwù, yì liǎn xīngfèn de pǎole jìnlái.
english: She ran in, holding the present, looking absolutely thrilled.

chinese: 小明见到了自己喜欢的作家，满脸高兴。
pinyin: Xiǎo Míng jiàndàole zìjǐ xǐhuan de zuòjiā, mǎnliǎn gāoxìng.
english: Xiao Ming was over the moon when he met his favourite author.

chinese: 我不知道从哪儿弄了一手油。
pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdao cóng nǎr nòngle yì shǒu yóu.
english: I don't know where I got hold of some oil.

chinese: 他从小练习书法，写得一手好字。
pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo liànxí shūfǎ, xiě de yì shǒu hǎo zì.
english: He has been practising calligraphy since childhood and has a beautiful hand.

chinese: 我从国外买回来一盒巧克力。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng guówài mǎihuílai yì hé qiǎokèlì.
english: I brought back a box of chocolates from abroad.

chinese: 老师让我们准备一盒画笔。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen zhǔnbèi yì hé huàbǐ.
english: The teacher asked us to bring a box of coloured pencils.

chinese: 我非常喜欢读书，家里有一屋子的书。
pinyin: Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan dúshū, jiā lǐ yǒu yì wūzi de shū.
english: I love reading very much; I have a room full of books at home.

chinese: 我有一屋子的衣服，你随便选。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yì wūzi de yīfu, nǐ suíbiàn xuǎn.
english: I've got a house full of clothes; help yourself.

chinese: 听到这个消息，一桌子的人都很开心。
pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, yì zhuōzi de rén dōu hěn kāixīn.
english: Upon hearing the news, everyone at the table was delighted.

chinese: 我每次回家，父母都会准备一桌子饭菜。
pinyin: Wǒ měi cì huí jiā, fùmǔ dōu huì zhǔnbèi yì zhuōzi fàncài.
english: Whenever I go home, my parents always lay on a feast.

chinese: 大卫参加了一场文化活动，体验了美食和音乐。
pinyin: Dàwèi cānjiāle yì chǎng wénhuà huódòng, tǐyànle měishí hé yīnyuè.
english: David took part in a cultural event, where he enjoyed the food and music.

chinese: 同学们都想在中国观看一场京剧演出。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen dōu xiǎng zài Zhōngguó guānkàn yì chǎng Jīngjù yǎnchū.
english: The students would all like to see a Peking Opera performance in China.

chinese: 周末咱们去饭馆好好吃一顿，怎么样？
pinyin: Zhōumò zánmen qù fànguǎn hǎohǎo chī yí dùn, zěnmeyàng?
english: How about we go out for a proper meal at a restaurant this weekend?

chinese: 中秋节我们一起吃了一顿饭。
pinyin: Zhōngqiū Jié wǒmen yìqǐ chīle yí dùn fàn.
english: We had a meal together on the Mid-Autumn Festival.

chinese: 我假期打算回一趟家，看看父母。
pinyin: Wǒ jiàqī dǎsuàn huí yí tàng jiā, kànkan fùmǔ.
english: I'm planning to pop back home during the holidays to see my parents.

chinese: 我刚才去了一趟办公室，没看见王老师。
pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái qùle yí tàng bàngōngshì, méi kànjiàn Wáng lǎoshī.
english: I popped into the office a moment ago, but I didn't see Mr Wang.

chinese: 她十分激动地对我们表示感谢。
pinyin: Tā shífēn jīdòng de duì wǒmen biǎoshì gǎnxiè.
english: She expressed her gratitude to us with great emotion.

chinese: 那位导游对游客十分热情。
pinyin: Nà wèi dǎoyóu duì yóukè shífēn rèqíng.
english: That tour guide was very friendly towards the tourists.

chinese: 随着互联网的发展，网上购物变得更加方便了。
pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, wǎngshàng gòuwù biàn de gèngjiā fāngbiàn le.
english: With the development of the internet, online shopping has become much more convenient.

chinese: 读完这本书，他对中国历史更加感兴趣了。
pinyin: Dúwán zhè běn shū, tā duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ gèngjiā gǎn xìngqù le.
english: After reading this book, he became even more interested in Chinese history.

chinese: 请您在这儿稍等一下，王经理马上就到。
pinyin: Qǐng nín zài zhèr shāo děng yíxià, Wáng jīnglǐ mǎshàng jiù dào.
english: Please wait here for a moment; Manager Wang will be with you shortly.

chinese: 对于这个词，两本词典的解释稍有不同。
pinyin: Duìyú zhège cí, liǎng běn cídiǎn de jiěshì shāo yǒu bùtóng.
english: The definitions of this word in the two dictionaries differ slightly.

chinese: 如果裙子的颜色稍微浅一点儿，那就更好了。
pinyin: Rúguǒ qúnzi de yánsè shāowēi qiǎn yìdiǎnr, nà jiù gèng hǎo le.
english: It would be even better if the skirt were a little lighter in colour.

chinese: 你能不能把字写得稍微大一些？
pinyin: Nǐ néng bu néng bǎ zì xiě de shāowēi dà yìxiē?
english: Could you please write the text a bit larger?

chinese: 人与人之间，尤其是父母和孩子之间，相互理解是很重要的。
pinyin: Rén yǔ rén zhījiān, yóuqí shì fùmǔ hé háizi zhījiān, xiānghù lǐjiě shì hěn zhòngyào de.
english: Mutual understanding is very important between people, particularly between parents and children.

chinese: 刚开始，我对这里的生活很不适应，尤其不习惯吃中国菜。
pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ duì zhèlǐ de shēnghuó hěn bú shìyìng, yóuqí bù xíguàn chī Zhōngguó cài.
english: At first, I found it very difficult to adjust to life here; I particularly struggled to get used to eating Chinese food.

chinese: 你听，她唱得多么好听啊！
pinyin: Nǐ tīng, tā chàng de duōme hǎotīng a!
english: Listen, she sings so beautifully!

chinese: 成为母亲以后，我才明白教育孩子有多么不容易。
pinyin: Chéngwéi mǔqīn yǐhòu, wǒ cái míngbai jiàoyù háizi yǒu duōme bù róngyì.
english: It was only after becoming a mother that I realised just how difficult it is to bring up children.

chinese: 上一年大学，学费和生活费共需多少钱？
pinyin: Shàng yì nián dàxué, xuéfèi hé shēnghuófèi gòng xū duōshao qián?
english: How much does it cost in total for tuition fees and living expenses for one year at university?

chinese: 中国人习惯一家人共吃一桌菜。
pinyin: Zhōngguórén xíguàn yì jiā rén gòng chī yì zhuō cài.
english: It is customary for Chinese families to share a meal together at the same table.

chinese: 昨天学习的生词和语法我已经全记住了。
pinyin: Zuótiān xuéxí de shēngcí hé yǔfǎ wǒ yǐjīng quán jìzhù le.
english: I've already learnt all the new vocabulary and grammar we covered yesterday.

chinese: 全班同学都报名参加了这次的运动会。
pinyin: Quán bān tóngxué dōu bàomíng cānjiāle zhè cì de yùndònghuì.
english: The whole class signed up to take part in this sports day.

chinese: 光这一间教室，他就打扫了一整天。
pinyin: Guāng zhè yì jiān jiàoshì, tā jiù dǎsǎole yì zhěngtiān.
english: He spent the whole day cleaning this one classroom alone.

chinese: 你不能光练口语，不练汉字，这样你的中文水平很难提高。
pinyin: Nǐ bùnéng guāng liàn kǒuyǔ, bú liàn hànzì, zhèyàng nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng hěn nán tígāo.
english: You cannot just practise speaking without practising Chinese characters; if you do, it will be very difficult to improve your Chinese.

chinese: 这个公园平时不开，仅在周末开放。
pinyin: Zhège gōngyuán píngshí bù kāi, jǐn zài zhōumò kāifàng.
english: This park is not usually open; it is only open at weekends.

chinese: 他仅用一年多的时间就学完了高中所有的课程。
pinyin: Tā jǐn yòng yì nián duō de shíjiān jiù xuéwánle gāozhōng suǒyǒu de kèchéng.
english: He completed the entire high school curriculum in just over a year.

chinese: 她仅仅去过一次，就深深地爱上了那里。
pinyin: Tā jǐnjǐn qùguo yí cì, jiù shēnshēn de àishangle nàlǐ.
english: She had only been there once, but she fell deeply in love with the place.

chinese: 你想学好中文，仅仅有想法是不够的，必须努力学习。
pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xuéhǎo Zhōngwén, jǐnjǐn yǒu xiǎngfǎ shì bú gòu de, bìxū nǔlì xuéxí.
english: If you want to learn Chinese well, simply having the intention is not enough; you must work hard at it.

chinese: 你们两个人一起去，遇到问题至少能商量一下。
pinyin: Nǐmen liǎng ge rén yìqǐ qù, yùdào wèntí zhìshǎo néng shāngliang yíxià.
english: If the two of you go together, you'll at least be able to discuss things if any problems arise.

chinese: 那里的景点很多，都参观完至少要三天的时间。
pinyin: Nàlǐ de jǐngdiǎn hěn duō, dōu cānguānwán zhìshǎo yào sān tiān de shíjiān.
english: There are many attractions there; it would take at least three days to see them all.

chinese: 时间很紧张，但我们必须按时完成任务。
pinyin: Shíjiān hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn wǒmen bìxū ànshí wánchéng rènwu.
english: Time is tight, but we must complete the task on schedule.

chinese: 医生让我回家按时吃药，多喝热水。
pinyin: Yīshēng ràng wǒ huí jiā ànshí chī yào, duō hē rè shuǐ.
english: The doctor told me to go home, take my medicine on time and drink plenty of hot water.

chinese: 我从来没有离开过家乡，父母不放心我一个人出国留学。
pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu líkāiguo jiāxiāng, fùmǔ bú fàngxīn wǒ yí ge rén chūguó liúxué.
english: I have never left my hometown, and my parents are worried about me going abroad to study on my own.

chinese: 我常常吃饺子，可是从来不知道饺子是怎么做的。
pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng chī jiǎozi, kěshì cónglái bù zhīdao jiǎozi shì zěnme zuò de.
english: I often eat dumplings, but I've never known how they're made.

chinese: 服务员见到我们，赶紧跑过来，热情地说“欢迎”。
pinyin: Fúwùyuán jiàndào wǒmen, gǎnjǐn pǎoguòlai, rèqíng de shuō "huānyíng".
english: As soon as the waiter saw us, he hurried over and said a warm ‘Welcome'.

chinese: 这儿的风景太漂亮了，我得赶紧拍几张照片。
pinyin: Zhèr de fēngjǐng tài piàoliang le, wǒ děi gǎnjǐn pāi jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn.
english: The scenery here is so beautiful; I'd better take a few photos straight away.

chinese: 咱们赶快往前走，大家都在前面等着呢。
pinyin: Zánmen gǎnkuài wǎng qián zǒu, dàjiā dōu zài qiánmian děngzhe ne.
english: Let's hurry on; everyone's waiting for us up ahead.

chinese: 你现在赶快叫一辆出租车，马上出发。
pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài gǎnkuài jiào yí liàng chūzūchē, mǎshàng chūfā.
english: Go and hail a taxi straight away and set off immediately.

chinese: 到今年十月，公司的收入已超过去年。
pinyin: Dào jīnnián shí yuè, gōngsī de shōurù yǐ chāoguò qùnián.
english: By October this year, the company's revenue had already exceeded last year's figure.

chinese: 他的父亲已有五十多岁，两个姐姐也都已结婚了。
pinyin: Tā de fùqīn yǐ yǒu wǔshí duō suì, liǎng ge jiějie yě dōu yǐ jiéhūn le.
english: His father is in his fifties, and his two older sisters are both married.

chinese: 看着儿子努力学习的样子，我忽然觉得他长大了。
pinyin: Kànzhe érzi nǔlì xuéxí de yàngzi, wǒ hūrán juéde tā zhǎngdà le.
english: Watching my son studying so hard, I suddenly realised how much he'd grown up.

chinese: 忽然，我听到一个声音说“小伙子，等一等”。
pinyin: Hūrán, wǒ tīngdào yí ge shēngyīn shuō "xiǎohuǒzi, děng yi děng".
english: Suddenly, I heard a voice say, ‘Young man, wait a moment.'

chinese: 比赛一结束，他就将自己获奖的消息告诉了父母。
pinyin: Bǐsài yì jiéshù, tā jiù jiāng zìjǐ huòjiǎng de xiāoxi gàosule fùmǔ.
english: As soon as the competition was over, he told his parents that he had won a prize.

chinese: 如果孩子学到自己感兴趣的知识，他的能力将得到更好的发展。
pinyin: Rúguǒ háizi xuédào zìjǐ gǎn xìngqù de zhīshi, tā de nénglì jiāng dédào gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn.
english: If a child learns about subjects that interest them, their abilities will develop more effectively.

chinese: 根据计划，公司下周将要推出新产品。
pinyin: Gēnjù jìhuà, gōngsī xià zhōu jiāngyào tuīchū xīn chǎnpǐn.
english: According to the plan, the company is set to launch a new product next week.

chinese: 学校最近将要安排我们到南方进行调查研究。
pinyin: Xuéxiào zuìjìn jiāngyào ānpái wǒmen dào nánfāng jìnxíng diàochá yánjiū.
english: The school is planning to send us to the south for a research trip shortly.

chinese: 我从没有听说过这个消息。
pinyin: Wǒ cóng méiyǒu tīngshuōguo zhège xiāoxi.
english: I've never heard of this before.

chinese: 父母总是鼓励我，从不批评我。
pinyin: Fùmǔ zǒngshì gǔlì wǒ, cóng bù pīpíng wǒ.
english: My parents always encouraged me and never criticised me.

chinese: 我本来计划学习一年中文就回国工作，现在我想继续学下去。
pinyin: Wǒ běnlái jìhuà xuéxí yì nián Zhōngwén jiù huí guó gōngzuò, xiànzài wǒ xiǎng jìxù xuéxiàqu.
english: I had originally planned to study Chinese for a year and then return home to work, but now I'd like to carry on studying.

chinese: 我本来以为父母会反对我留在中国，没想到他们竟然这么支持。
pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi fùmǔ huì fǎnduì wǒ liú zài Zhōngguó, méi xiǎngdào tāmen jìngrán zhème zhīchí.
english: I'd thought my parents would be against me staying in China, but I never expected them to be so supportive.

chinese: 我们需要重新安排会议时间。
pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn ānpái huìyì shíjiān.
english: We need to reschedule the meeting.

chinese: 这个问题，您能不能重新考虑一下？
pinyin: Zhège wèntí, nín néng bu néng chóngxīn kǎolǜ yíxià?
english: Could you please give this matter some further thought?

chinese: 其实，一些看起来很小的事情往往会影响人的一生。
pinyin: Qíshí, yìxiē kànqǐlai hěn xiǎo de shìqing wǎngwǎng huì yǐngxiǎng rén de yìshēng.
english: In fact, things that seem trivial can often have a lasting impact on a person's life.

chinese: 这两个词意思差不多，如果不知道它们的区别，往往容易用错。
pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge cí yìsi chàbuduō, rúguǒ bù zhīdao tāmen de qūbié, wǎngwǎng róngyì yòngcuò.
english: These two words have similar meanings, and if you are unaware of the difference between them, it is easy to use them incorrectly.

chinese: 他平时工作很忙，回家以后看看书、上上网，偶尔运动一下，就睡觉了。
pinyin: Tā píngshí gōngzuò hěn máng, huí jiā yǐhòu kànkan shū, shàngshang wǎng, ǒu'ěr yùndòng yíxià, jiù shuìjiào le.
english: He's usually very busy at work; when he gets home, he reads a book, surfs the internet, does a bit of exercise now and then, and then goes to bed.

chinese: 我们偶尔会一起出去玩儿，有时候看电影，有时候踢足球。
pinyin: Wǒmen ǒu'ěr huì yìqǐ chūqù wánr, yǒu shíhou kàn diànyǐng, yǒu shíhou tī zúqiú.
english: We occasionally go out together; sometimes we go to the cinema, and sometimes we play football.

chinese: 老师再次提醒同学们考试以前一定要认真复习。
pinyin: Lǎoshī zàicì tíxǐng tóngxuémen kǎoshì yǐqián yídìng yào rènzhēn fùxí.
english: The teacher reminded the pupils once again that they must revise thoroughly before the exam.

chinese: 再次回到童年时生活的地方，我感到既熟悉又感动。
pinyin: Zàicì huídào tóngnián shí shēnghuó de dìfang, wǒ gǎndào jì shúxī yòu gǎndòng.
english: Returning once again to the place where I grew up, I felt both a sense of familiarity and deep emotion.

chinese: 他老说要跟同学们多交流，可是从来不参加班级活动。
pinyin: Tā lǎo shuō yào gēn tóngxuémen duō jiāoliú, kěshì cónglái bù cānjiā bānjí huódòng.
english: He's always saying he wants to socialise more with his classmates, but he never takes part in class activities.

chinese: 大家的工作都很忙，你老想让别人照顾你，是不可能的。
pinyin: Dàjiā de gōngzuò dōu hěn máng, nǐ lǎo xiǎng ràng biéren zhàogù nǐ, shì bù kěnéng de.
english: Everyone's very busy with their work; you can't expect people to look after you all the time.

chinese: 真对不起，我不是故意的，你千万别生气。
pinyin: Zhēn duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú shì gùyì de, nǐ qiānwàn bié shēngqì.
english: I'm really sorry, I didn't mean to do that – please don't be angry.

chinese: 他故意提高声音，好让大家都能听见。
pinyin: Tā gùyì tígāo shēngyīn, hǎo ràng dàjiā dōu néng tīngjiàn.
english: He deliberately raised his voice so that everyone could hear him.

chinese: 我想练习中文，咱们互相学习，互相帮助，怎么样？
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng liànxí Zhōngwén, zánmen hùxiāng xuéxí, hùxiāng bāngzhù, zěnmeyàng?
english: I'd like to practise my Chinese. Shall we learn from each other and help one another?

chinese: 大家都是同学，应该互相关心，互相照顾。
pinyin: Dàjiā dōu shì tóngxué, yīnggāi hùxiāng guānxīn, hùxiāng zhàogù.
english: We're all classmates, so we should look out for one another and look after one another.

chinese: 国家之间应该相互尊重，相互交流，共同发展。
pinyin: Guójiā zhījiān yīnggāi xiānghù zūnzhòng, xiānghù jiāoliú, gòngtóng fāzhǎn.
english: Countries should respect one another, engage in mutual exchange and pursue common development.

chinese: 随着信息技术的发展，不同语言的相互影响越来越普遍。
pinyin: Suízhe xìnxī jìshù de fāzhǎn, bùtóng yǔyán de xiānghù yǐngxiǎng yuèláiyuè pǔbiàn.
english: With the development of information technology, mutual influence between different languages is becoming increasingly common.

chinese: 有些打折的商品尽管便宜，质量却不能让人满意。
pinyin: Yǒuxiē dǎzhé de shāngpǐn jǐnguǎn piányi, zhìliàng què bùnéng ràng rén mǎnyì.
english: Although some discounted items are cheap, their quality leaves much to be desired.

chinese: 她长得很像她的姐姐，但两个人的性格却完全不同。
pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā de jiějie, dàn liǎng ge rén de xìnggé què wánquán bùtóng.
english: She looks a lot like her sister, but their personalities are completely different.

chinese: 你可以加一点儿糖，味道也许不错。
pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎnr táng, wèidao yěxǔ búcuò.
english: You could add a little sugar; it might taste quite nice.

chinese: 现在不愿意花时间练习写汉字，你将来也许会后悔的。
pinyin: Xiànzài bú yuànyì huā shíjiān liànxí xiě hànzì, nǐ jiānglái yěxǔ huì hòuhuǐ de.
english: If you're not willing to spend time practising writing Chinese characters now, you might regret it later.

chinese: 我感觉头疼，还有点儿咳嗽，恐怕是感冒了。
pinyin: Wǒ gǎnjué tóuténg, hái yǒudiǎnr késou, kǒngpà shì gǎnmào le.
english: I've got a headache and a slight cough; I'm afraid I've caught a cold.

chinese: 年底是公司最忙的时候，你想休假恐怕不行。
pinyin: Niándǐ shì gōngsī zuì máng de shíhou, nǐ xiǎng xiūjià kǒngpà bùxíng.
english: The end of the year is the busiest time for the company, so I'm afraid you won't be able to take leave.

chinese: 昨天那场比赛才精彩呢！
pinyin: Zuótiān nà chǎng bǐsài cái jīngcǎi ne!
english: That match yesterday was absolutely brilliant!

chinese: 他总是迟到，我才不相信他今天能准时来。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì chídào, wǒ cái bù xiāngxìn tā jīntiān néng zhǔnshí lái.
english: He's always late, so I don't believe for a moment that he'll turn up on time today.

chinese: 我就知道他肯定会答应的。
pinyin: Wǒ jiù zhīdao tā kěndìng huì dāying de.
english: I just knew he'd say yes.

chinese: 我就不信我考不上大学。
pinyin: Wǒ jiù bú xìn wǒ kǎobushàng dàxué.
english: I just don't believe I won't get into university.

chinese: 她并不相信我说的话。
pinyin: Tā bìng bù xiāngxìn wǒ shuō de huà.
english: She didn't believe what I said.

chinese: 我以为考试很简单，其实并没有那么简单。
pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi kǎoshì hěn jiǎndān, qíshí bìng méiyǒu nàme jiǎndān.
english: I thought the exam would be easy, but it wasn't quite that simple.

chinese: 没想到他的中文说得还真不错。
pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào tā de Zhōngwén shuō de hái zhēn búcuò.
english: I didn't expect his Chinese to be quite so good.

chinese: 老张还真厉害，这么快就把问题解决了。
pinyin: Lǎo Zhāng hái zhēn lìhai, zhème kuài jiù bǎ wèntí jiějué le.
english: Old Zhang really is brilliant—he's sorted the problem out so quickly.

chinese: 他竟然在那么短的时间内完成了这么复杂的工作，太厉害了。
pinyin: Tā jìngrán zài nàme duǎn de shíjiān nèi wánchéngle zhème fùzá de gōngzuò, tài lìhai le.
english: He actually managed to complete such a complex task in such a short space of time – that's brilliant.

chinese: 昨天天气还很暖和，没想到今天竟然下雪了。
pinyin: Zuótiān tiānqì hái hěn nuǎnhuo, méi xiǎngdào jīntiān jìngrán xià xuě le.
english: It was still quite warm yesterday; I never expected it to snow today.

chinese: 他究竟是不是真的喜欢我，我还是有些怀疑。
pinyin: Tā jiūjìng shì bu shì zhēn de xǐhuan wǒ, wǒ háishi yǒuxiē huáiyí.
english: I'm still a bit unsure whether he really likes me or not.

chinese: 我很想知道汉字究竟是怎么产生的。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng zhīdao hànzì jiūjìng shì zěnme chǎnshēng de.
english: I'm very curious to know exactly how Chinese characters came into being.

chinese: 我明天下午正好有时间，可以帮你一起搬家。
pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān xiàwǔ zhènghǎo yǒu shíjiān, kěyǐ bāng nǐ yìqǐ bānjiā.
english: I happen to be free tomorrow afternoon, so I can help you move house.

chinese: 上个月我借了一本书，今天正好一个月了，你帮我还回去吧。
pinyin: Shàng ge yuè wǒ jièle yì běn shū, jīntiān zhènghǎo yí ge yuè le, nǐ bāng wǒ huánhuíqu ba.
english: I borrowed a book last month; it's been exactly a month today, so could you please return it for me?

chinese: 明天就是最后一天了，你到底想不想报名？
pinyin: Míngtiān jiùshì zuìhòu yì tiān le, nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng bàomíng?
english: Tomorrow's the last day – are you going to sign up or not?

chinese: 昨天的比赛你看了吗？他们队到底赢了没有？
pinyin: Zuótiān de bǐsài nǐ kàn le ma? Tāmen duì dàodǐ yíng le méiyǒu?
english: Did you watch yesterday's match? Did their team actually win?

chinese: 难道你不知道坐飞机需要带护照吗？
pinyin: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdao zuò fēijī xūyào dài hùzhào ma?
english: Don't you know you need to bring your passport when you fly?

chinese: 你难道不认为网上购物更方便吗？
pinyin: Nǐ nándào bú rènwéi wǎngshàng gòuwù gèng fāngbiàn ma?
english: Don't you think online shopping is more convenient?

chinese: 你把地址写在这儿，千万别写错了。
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ dìzhǐ xiě zài zhèr, qiānwàn bié xiěcuò le.
english: Please write the address here – make sure you don't get it wrong.

chinese: 路上人多车也多，骑车时千万要小心。
pinyin: Lùshang rén duō chē yě duō, qí chē shí qiānwàn yào xiǎoxīn.
english: There are lots of people and cars on the roads, so please be very careful when cycling.

chinese: 昨天晚上的京剧演出确实精彩。
pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshang de jīngjù yǎnchū quèshí jīngcǎi.
english: Last night's Peking Opera performance was truly brilliant.

chinese: 跟过去相比，这里确实发生了巨大的变化。
pinyin: Gēn guòqù xiāngbǐ, zhèlǐ quèshí fāshēngle jùdà de biànhuà.
english: Compared to the past, there have certainly been huge changes here.

chinese: 电梯坏了，我们只好走楼梯上去。
pinyin: Diàntī huài le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zǒu lóutī shàngqù.
english: The lift was out of order, so we had to take the stairs.

chinese: 因为没买到火车票，我假期只好留在学校。
pinyin: Yīnwèi méi mǎidào huǒchēpiào, wǒ jiàqī zhǐhǎo liú zài xuéxiào.
english: As I couldn't get a train ticket, I had no choice but to stay at university over the holidays.

chinese: 出门的时候太着急，我差（一）点儿忘带手机。
pinyin: Chūmén de shíhou tài zháojí, wǒ chà (yì) diǎnr wàng dài shǒujī.
english: I was in such a rush when I left the house that I nearly forgot my mobile.

chinese: 我早上七点半才起床，差（一）点儿没迟到。
pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn cái qǐchuáng, chà (yì) diǎnr méi chídào.
english: I didn't get up until half past seven this morning; I was very nearly late.

chinese: 自1978年以来，中国发生了很大的变化。
pinyin: Zì yī jiǔ qī bā nián yǐlái, Zhōngguó fāshēngle hěn dà de biànhuà.
english: China has undergone significant changes since 1978.

chinese: 我们自北京出发，开车往南走，来到了上海。
pinyin: Wǒmen zì Běijīng chūfā, kāi chē wǎng nán zǒu, láidàole Shànghǎi.
english: We set off from Beijing, drove south, and arrived in Shanghai.

chinese: 当遇到困难时，先冷静地想一想。
pinyin: Dāng yùdào kùnnan shí, xiān lěngjìng de xiǎng yi xiǎng.
english: When you encounter difficulties, take a moment to think calmly.

chinese: 当听到放假的消息时，同学们都非常高兴。
pinyin: Dāng tīngdào fàngjià de xiāoxi shí, tóngxuémen dōu fēicháng gāoxìng.
english: When they heard the news that they were off school, the pupils were all delighted.

chinese: 各位乘客，由北京飞往上海的航班就要起飞了。
pinyin: Gèwèi chéngkè, yóu Běijīng fēiwǎng Shànghǎi de hángbān jiù yào qǐfēi le.
english: Ladies and gentlemen, the flight from Beijing to Shanghai is about to depart.

chinese: 学校决定由下个月开始每周增加一节中文课。
