pinyin: Xuéxiào juédìng yóu xià ge yuè kāishǐ měi zhōu zēngjiā yì jié Zhōngwén kè.
english: The school has decided to add one extra Chinese lesson per week from next month.

chinese: 随着生活水平的提高，人们对食品健康的要求越来越高。
pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, rénmen duì shípǐn jiànkāng de yāoqiú yuèláiyuè gāo.
english: As living standards rise, people are placing ever greater emphasis on the healthiness of their food.

chinese: 随着春天的到来，天气一天比一天暖和了。
pinyin: Suízhe chūntiān de dàolái, tiānqì yì tiān bǐ yì tiān nuǎnhuo le.
english: With the arrival of spring, the weather is getting warmer day by day.

chinese: 等我写完作业，咱们一起去踢足球。
pinyin: Děng wǒ xiěwán zuòyè, zánmen yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú.
english: Once I've finished my homework, let's go and play football together.

chinese: 等我们赶到车站，火车已经开走了。
pinyin: Děng wǒmen gǎndào chēzhàn, huǒchē yǐjīng kāizǒu le.
english: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.

chinese: 离开教室时，请将垃圾带走，并将门窗关好。
pinyin: Líkāi jiàoshì shí, qǐng jiāng lājī dàizǒu, bìng jiāng ménchuāng guānhǎo.
english: When leaving the classroom, please take your rubbish with you and ensure that the doors and windows are closed.

chinese: 根据规定，禁止将食物带入图书馆。
pinyin: Gēnjù guīdìng, jìnzhǐ jiāng shíwù dàirù túshūguǎn.
english: In accordance with the regulations, food is not permitted in the library.

chinese: 这些商品的质量问题应该由工厂负责。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn de zhìliàng wèntí yīnggāi yóu gōngchǎng fùzé.
english: The factory should be held responsible for the quality issues with these goods.

chinese: 我只是提供一些建议，到底怎么做由你决定。
pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì tígōng yìxiē jiànyì, dàodǐ zěnme zuò yóu nǐ juédìng.
english: I'm just offering some advice; it's up to you to decide what to do.

chinese: 我刚才放在桌上的那些文件叫谁拿走了？
pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái fàng zài zhuō shàng de nàxiē wénjiàn jiào shéi názǒu le?
english: Who took those documents I'd just left on the desk?

chinese: 我本来想去图书馆借书，可是学生证让我弄丢了。
pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, kěshì xuéshengzhèng ràng wǒ nòngdiū le.
english: I was going to go to the library to borrow some books, but I've lost my student card.

chinese: 由于上次失败的经历，她对自己失去了信心。
pinyin: Yóuyú shàng cì shībài de jīnglì, tā duì zìjǐ shīqùle xìnxīn.
english: Because of her previous failure, she lost confidence in herself.

chinese: 由于工作的原因，我一年内搬了好几次家。
pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò de yuányīn, wǒ yì nián nèi bānle hǎo jǐ cì jiā.
english: Due to my job, I've moved house several times in the space of a year.

chinese: 对于任何一种语言，文字的出现都是十分重要的。
pinyin: Duìyú rènhé yì zhǒng yǔyán, wénzì de chūxiàn dōu shì shífēn zhòngyào de.
english: The emergence of writing is of great importance to any language.

chinese: 对于学习成绩优秀的同学，学校每年都会提供奖学金。
pinyin: Duìyú xuéxí chéngjì yōuxiù de tóngxué, xuéxiào měinián dōu huì tígōng jiǎngxuéjīn.
english: The school offers scholarships every year to students with excellent academic results.

chinese: 你放心，我们会与你共同解决这个问题。
pinyin: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒmen huì yǔ nǐ gòngtóng jiějué zhège wèntí.
english: Rest assured, we will work with you to resolve this issue.

chinese: 这件事我没与任何人交流过。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ méi yǔ rènhé rén jiāoliúguo.
english: I haven't spoken to anyone about this.

chinese: 作为生活在中国的外国人，我很想了解中国人的生活习惯。
pinyin: Zuòwéi shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó de wàiguórén, wǒ hěn xiǎng liǎojiě Zhōngguórén de shēnghuó xíguàn.
english: As a foreigner living in China, I am very keen to learn about the lifestyle of the Chinese people.

chinese: 作为首都，北京的发展比一般的城市更快，工作机会更多。
pinyin: Zuòwéi shǒudū, Běijīng de fāzhǎn bǐ yìbān de chéngshì gèng kuài, gōngzuò jīhuì gèng duō.
english: As the capital, Beijing develops at a faster pace than most other cities and offers more job opportunities.

chinese: 你应该按医生说的方法坚持锻炼。
pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi àn yīshēng shuō de fāngfǎ jiānchí duànliàn.
english: You should stick to the exercise routine recommended by your doctor.

chinese: 这里租房子比较方便，房租可以按月付，也可以按天付。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ zū fángzi bǐjiào fāngbiàn, fángzū kěyǐ àn yuè fù, yě kěyǐ àn tiān fù.
english: It's quite easy to rent a flat here; you can pay the rent either monthly or by the day.

chinese: 按照北方人的习惯，过年一般要吃饺子。
pinyin: Ànzhào běifāngrén de xíguàn, guònián yìbān yào chī jiǎozi.
english: In keeping with northern Chinese tradition, it is customary to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.

chinese: 我们已经按照计划完成了全部工作。
pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng ànzhào jìhuà wánchéngle quánbù gōngzuò.
english: We have completed all the work as planned.

chinese: 学校同意并支持学生们的想法。
pinyin: Xuéxiào tóngyì bìng zhīchí xuéshengmen de xiǎngfǎ.
english: The school agrees with and supports the students' ideas.

chinese: 公司讨论并通过了这项计划。
pinyin: Gōngsī tǎolùn bìng tōngguòle zhè xiàng jìhuà.
english: The company discussed and approved the plan.

chinese: 这里的人民热情而友好。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rénmín rèqíng ér yǒuhǎo.
english: The people here are warm and friendly.

chinese: 她工作起来积极而努力。
pinyin: Tā gōngzuò qǐlái jījí ér nǔlì.
english: She is enthusiastic and hard-working in her job.

chinese: 学校与家庭对孩子的影响同样重要。
pinyin: Xuéxiào yǔ jiātíng duì háizi de yǐngxiǎng tóngyàng zhòngyào.
english: School and home are equally important in shaping a child's development.

chinese: 课程目标是帮助学生提高阅读能力与听说能力。
pinyin: Kèchéng mùbiāo shì bāngzhù xuésheng tígāo yuèdú nénglì yǔ tīngshuō nénglì.
english: The aim of the course is to help students improve their reading, listening and speaking skills.

chinese: 我每天要上两节中文课，此外一周还要参加一次文化活动。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān yào shàng liǎng jié Zhōngwén kè, cǐwài yì zhōu hái yào cānjiā yí cì wénhuà huódòng.
english: I have two Chinese lessons every day, and I also take part in a cultural activity once a week.

chinese: 我来中国是想提高自己的汉语水平，此外还想学习中国文化。
pinyin: Wǒ lái Zhōngguó shì xiǎng tígāo zìjǐ de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng, cǐwài hái xiǎng xuéxí Zhōngguó wénhuà.
english: I came to China to improve my Chinese and also to learn about Chinese culture.

chinese: 冬天的时候，北方下雪比较多，而南方下雪比较少。
pinyin: Dōngtiān de shíhou, běifāng xià xuě bǐjiào duō, ér nánfāng xià xuě bǐjiào shǎo.
english: In winter, it snows quite a lot in the north, whereas it snows relatively little in the south.

chinese: 他们兄弟的性格完全不同，哥哥喜欢热闹，而弟弟喜欢安静。
pinyin: Tāmen xiōngdì de xìnggé wánquán bùtóng, gēge xǐhuan rènao, ér dìdi xǐhuan ānjìng.
english: The brothers have completely different personalities; the elder brother likes a lively atmosphere, whilst the younger brother prefers peace and quiet.

chinese: 你说得对，既然来了中国，就要学习一些中国的文化。
pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì, jìrán láile Zhōngguó, jiù yào xuéxí yìxiē Zhōngguó de wénhuà.
english: You're right; now that I'm here in China, I should learn a bit about Chinese culture.

chinese: 既然你决定应聘那份工作，就应该认真准备面试。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juédìng yìngpìn nà fèn gōngzuò, jiù yīnggāi rènzhēn zhǔnbèi miànshì.
english: Now that you've decided to apply for that job, you should prepare thoroughly for the interview.

chinese: 活动还没开始，教室里就坐满了人，甚至还有人站在后面。
pinyin: Huódòng hái méi kāishǐ, jiàoshì lǐ jiù zuòmǎnle rén, shènzhì hái yǒu rén zhàn zài hòumian.
english: The event hadn't even started yet, but the classroom was already full, with some people even standing at the back.

chinese: 他最近工作很忙，有时候甚至连吃饭的时间都没有。
pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn máng, yǒu shíhou shènzhì lián chī fàn de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
english: He's been very busy at work recently; sometimes he doesn't even have time to eat.

chinese: 我姐姐还没有结婚，不过已经有男朋友了。
pinyin: Wǒ jiějie hái méiyǒu jiéhūn, búguò yǐjīng yǒu nán péngyou le.
english: My sister isn't married yet, but she does have a boyfriend.

chinese: 那家公司的地址我也不知道，不过我可以上网帮你查查。
pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī de dìzhǐ wǒ yě bù zhīdao, búguò wǒ kěyǐ shàngwǎng bāng nǐ chácha.
english: I don't know the address of that company either, but I can look it up for you online.

chinese: 从那天开始，我就跟着老师学习中国功夫，并且一直坚持到现在。
pinyin: Cóng nà tiān kāishǐ, wǒ jiù gēnzhe lǎoshī xuéxí Zhōngguó gōngfu, bìngqiě yìzhí jiānchí dào xiànzài.
english: From that day onwards, I began learning Chinese martial arts under my teacher's guidance, and I have kept it up ever since.

chinese: 她打算在中国学习中文，并且还想申请读研究生。
pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn zài Zhōngguó xuéxí Zhōngwén, bìngqiě hái xiǎng shēnqǐng dú yánjiūshēng.
english: She plans to study Chinese in China and would also like to apply for a postgraduate place.

chinese: 我不光要学习中文，还要学习中国的历史和文化。
pinyin: Wǒ bùguāng yào xuéxí Zhōngwén, hái yào xuéxí Zhōngguó de lìshǐ hé wénhuà.
english: I want to learn not only the Chinese language, but also Chinese history and culture.

chinese: 学校周围不光环境好，交通也很方便。
pinyin: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi bùguāng huánjìng hǎo, jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
english: Not only is the area around the school pleasant, but it is also well served by public transport.

chinese: 我弟弟不仅学习成绩好，而且性格也很好。
pinyin: Wǒ dìdi bùjǐn xuéxí chéngjì hǎo, érqiě xìnggé yě hěn hǎo.
english: My younger brother not only does well at school, but he also has a lovely personality.

chinese: 骑自行车旅行不仅便宜，还能锻炼身体。
pinyin: Qí zìxíngchē lǚxíng bùjǐn piányi, hái néng duànliàn shēntǐ.
english: Cycling holidays are not only inexpensive, but also a great way to keep fit.

chinese: 我大学学的是广告专业，另外还有三年工作经验。
pinyin: Wǒ dàxué xué de shì guǎnggào zhuānyè, lìngwài hái yǒu sān nián gōngzuò jīngyàn.
english: I studied advertising at university and have three years' work experience.

chinese: 这些商品质量不错，另外价格也比较便宜。
pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn zhìliàng búcuò, lìngwài jiàgé yě bǐjiào piányi.
english: These products are of good quality and are also quite reasonably priced.

chinese: 要是你也觉得满意，咱们就买吧。
pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yě juéde mǎnyì, zánmen jiù mǎi ba.
english: If you're happy with it too, let's go ahead and buy it.

chinese: 要是天气不好，明天的活动就取消。
pinyin: Yàoshi tiānqì bù hǎo, míngtiān de huódòng jiù qǔxiāo.
english: If the weather is bad, tomorrow's event will be cancelled.

chinese: 买汽车的人越来越多，因此堵车成为了城市交通的大问题。
pinyin: Mǎi qìchē de rén yuèláiyuè duō, yīncǐ dǔchē chéngwéile chéngshì jiāotōng de dà wèntí.
english: With more and more people buying cars, traffic congestion has become a major problem for urban transport.

chinese: 她在中国生活过，因此对中国文化有一些了解。
pinyin: Tā zài Zhōngguó shēnghuóguo, yīncǐ duì Zhōngguó wénhuà yǒu yìxiē liǎojiě.
english: She has lived in China, so she has some understanding of Chinese culture.

chinese: 由于去晚了，前面没有座位了，我只好坐在最后一排。
pinyin: Yóuyú qùwǎn le, qiánmian méiyǒu zuòwèi le, wǒ zhǐhǎo zuò zài zuìhòu yì pái.
english: As I arrived late, there were no seats left at the front, so I had to sit in the back row.

chinese: 由于天气原因，我们的航班被取消了。
pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, wǒmen de hángbān bèi qǔxiāo le.
english: Due to the weather, our flight was cancelled.

chinese: 我爸爸平时工作很忙，加上经常出差，有时候一周也见不到他。
pinyin: Wǒ bàba píngshí gōngzuò hěn máng, jiāshàng jīngcháng chūchāi, yǒu shíhou yì zhōu yě jiànbudào tā.
english: My dad is usually very busy with work, and as he's often away on business trips, there are times when I don't see him for a whole week.

chinese: 景区实在太大了，加上天气这么热，走了半天，我们又累又渴。
pinyin: Jǐngqū shízài tài dà le, jiāshàng tiānqì zhème rè, zǒule bàntiān, wǒmen yòu lèi yòu kě.
english: The scenic area was simply enormous, and with the weather being so hot, after walking for half a day, we were both tired and parched.

chinese: 我会说英语、汉语、法语等很多种语言。
pinyin: Wǒ huì shuō Yīngyǔ, Hànyǔ, Fǎyǔ děng hěn duō zhǒng yǔyán.
english: I speak many languages, including English, Chinese and French.

chinese: 你最好提前上网了解一下那里的天气、交通、景点等方面的信息。
pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo tíqián shàngwǎng liǎojiě yíxià nàlǐ de tiānqì, jiāotōng, jǐngdiǎn děng fāngmiàn de xìnxī.
english: You'd be well advised to check online in advance for information on the weather, transport and places of interest there.

chinese: 根据学校的规定，迟到十分钟以上者不允许参加考试。
pinyin: Gēnjù xuéxiào de guīdìng, chídào shí fēnzhōng yǐshàng zhě bù yǔnxǔ cānjiā kǎoshì.
english: In accordance with the school's regulations, students who arrive more than ten minutes late will not be permitted to sit the exam.

chinese: 申请参加会议者，请将您的个人信息发送到此邮箱。
pinyin: Shēnqǐng cānjiā huìyì zhě, qǐng jiāng nín de gèrén xìnxī fāsòng dào cǐ yóuxiāng.
english: If you wish to register for the conference, please send your personal details to this email address.

chinese: 其实，来中国留学一开始并不在我的计划之内。
pinyin: Qíshí, lái Zhōngguó liúxué yì kāishǐ bìng bú zài wǒ de jìhuà zhīnèi.
english: To be honest, studying in China wasn't part of my plans to begin with.

chinese: 我希望在提高中文水平的基础之上，能够学习一些专业知识。
pinyin: Wǒ xīwàng zài tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng de jīchǔ zhī shàng, nénggòu xuéxí yìxiē zhuānyè zhīshi.
english: I hope that, whilst improving my Chinese language skills, I will be able to acquire some specialist knowledge.

chinese: 我们明天一定完成任务，您放心就是了。
pinyin: Wǒmen míngtiān yídìng wánchéng rènwu, nín fàngxīn jiùshì le.
english: We'll definitely complete the task tomorrow, so please rest assured.

chinese: 我开车去学校接你，你在门口等我就是了。
pinyin: Wǒ kāi chē qù xuéxiào jiē nǐ, nǐ zài ménkǒu děng wǒ jiùshì le.
english: I'll drive to school to pick you up; just wait for me at the entrance.

chinese: 啊，原来是这么一回事！
pinyin: À, yuánlái shì zhème yì huí shì!
english: Ah, so that's how it is!

chinese: 啊，这么多人排队！
pinyin: À, zhème duō rén páiduì!
english: Oh, there's such a long queue!

chinese: A：八点出发来得及吗？
pinyin: A: Bā diǎn chūfā láidejí ma?
english: A: Will we have time if we set off at eight o'clock?

chinese: B：嗯，应该来得及。
pinyin: B: Èn, yīnggāi láidejí.
english: B: Hmm, I reckon we'll make it in time.

chinese: 奶奶把一小盒巧克力装进了孙子的书包里。
pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ yì xiǎo hé qiǎokèlì zhuāngjìnle sūnzi de shūbāo lǐ.
english: Grandma put a small box of chocolates into her grandson's schoolbag.

chinese: 回国前，我给父母买了两大包中国茶作为礼物。
pinyin: Huí guó qián, wǒ gěi fùmǔ mǎile liǎng dà bāo Zhōngguó chá zuòwéi lǐwù.
english: Before returning home, I bought two large bags of Chinese tea as a present for my parents.

chinese: 她说话的声音不大，但是一字一句说得很清楚。
pinyin: Tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn bú dà, dànshì yí zì yí jù shuō de hěn qīngchu.
english: She didn't speak very loudly, but she enunciated every word clearly.

chinese: 这会儿路上堵车，一来一回至少需要两个小时。
pinyin: Zhèhuìr lùshang dǔchē, yì lái yì huí zhìshǎo xūyào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
english: There's a traffic jam on the road at the moment, so it'll take at least two hours there and back.

chinese: 我无儿无女，一人吃饱全家不饿。
pinyin: Wǒ wú ér wú nǚ, yì rén chībǎo quánjiā bú è.
english: I have no children, so if I'm fed, the whole family is fed.

chinese: 母亲无日无夜地照顾着生病的孩子。
pinyin: Mǔqīn wú rì wú yè de zhàogùzhe shēngbìng de háizi.
english: The mother cared for her sick child day and night.

chinese: 下课了，同学们有说有笑地走出了教室。
pinyin: Xià kè le, tóngxuémen yǒu shuō yǒu xiào de zǒuchūle jiàoshì.
english: The lesson was over, and the pupils filed out of the classroom, chatting and laughing.

chinese: 这部作品的每个人物都写得有血有肉。
pinyin: Zhè bù zuòpǐn de měi ge rénwù dōu xiě de yǒu xuè yǒu ròu.
english: Every character in this work is portrayed in a vivid and lifelike manner.

chinese: 我这两天很忙，没来得及考虑这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒ zhè liǎng tiān hěn máng, méi láidejí kǎolǜ zhège wèntí.
english: I've been very busy these past couple of days, so I haven't had a chance to think about this.

chinese: 我想参加明天的比赛，现在报名来得及吗？
pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cānjiā míngtiān de bǐsài, xiànzài bàomíng láidejí ma?
english: I'd like to take part in tomorrow's competition. Is it still in time to register now?

chinese: 我发现这个问题时已经太晚了，来不及做出任何改变。
pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn zhège wèntí shí yǐjīng tài wǎn le, láibují zuòchū rènhé gǎibiàn.
english: By the time I realised there was a problem, it was already too late to make any changes.

chinese: 飞机就要起飞了，你得快一点儿，否则就来不及了。
pinyin: Fēijī jiù yào qǐfēi le, nǐ děi kuài yìdiǎnr, fǒuzé jiù láibují le.
english: The plane is about to take off; you'd better hurry, otherwise you'll miss it.

chinese: 一次失败并不可怕，以后有的是机会。
pinyin: Yí cì shībài bìng bù kěpà, yǐhòu yǒudeshì jīhuì.
english: One failure is nothing to worry about; there will be plenty of other opportunities in the future.

chinese: 这种水果我的家乡有的是。
pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ wǒ de jiāxiāng yǒudeshì.
english: There's plenty of this fruit in my hometown.

chinese: 客人来不来还说不定。
pinyin: Kèrén lái bu lái hái shuōbudìng.
english: It's still not certain whether the guests will come or not.

chinese: 说不定路上堵车，再等一会儿吧。
pinyin: Shuōbudìng lùshang dǔchē, zài děng yíhuìr ba.
english: There might be traffic on the way, so let's wait a bit longer.

chinese: 她从来都不怎么关心别人的看法。
pinyin: Tā cónglái dōu bù zěnme guānxīn biéren de kànfǎ.
english: She has never really cared much about what other people think.

chinese: 从检查结果来看，他受的伤不怎么严重。
pinyin: Cóng jiǎnchá jiéguǒ lái kàn, tā shòu de shāng bù zěnme yánzhòng.
english: Judging by the results of the examination, his injuries are not particularly serious.

chinese: 他们没有直接拒绝你，而是让你回来等消息，就是说，你还有机会，千万不要放弃。
pinyin: Tāmen méiyǒu zhíjiē jùjué nǐ, érshì ràng nǐ huílái děng xiāoxi, jiùshì shuō, nǐ hái yǒu jīhuì, qiānwàn bú yào fàngqì.
english: They didn't turn you down outright; instead, they asked you to come back and wait to hear from them. This means you still have a chance, so please don't give up.

chinese: 他总是为自己的错误找各种原因，这就是说，他是一个不愿意负责任的人。
pinyin: Tā zǒngshì wèi zìjǐ de cuòwù zhǎo gèzhǒng yuányīn, zhè jiùshì shuō, tā shì yí ge bú yuànyì fù zérèn de rén.
english: He is always making all sorts of excuses for his mistakes, which means he is someone who is unwilling to take responsibility.

chinese: 他的表演一次比一次精彩。
pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn yí cì bǐ yí cì jīngcǎi.
english: His performances are getting better and better.

chinese: 最近天气一天比一天暖和。
pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì yì tiān bǐ yì tiān nuǎnhuo.
english: The weather has been getting warmer day by day recently.

chinese: 在教育孩子方面，张老师有丰富的经验。
pinyin: Zài jiàoyù háizi fāngmiàn, Zhāng lǎoshī yǒu fēngfù de jīngyàn.
english: Mr Zhang has a wealth of experience in educating children.

chinese: 在生活方面，他还不太习惯。
pinyin: Zài shēnghuó fāngmiàn, tā hái bú tài xíguàn.
english: He's still not quite used to life here.

chinese: 这个房间真够大的，估计能住七八个人。
pinyin: Zhège fángjiān zhēn gòu dà de, gūjì néng zhù qī bā ge rén.
english: This room is really quite spacious; I reckon it could sleep seven or eight people.

chinese: 你男朋友真够浪漫的，每天都给你送一枝花。
pinyin: Nǐ nán péngyou zhēn gòu làngmàn de, měitiān dōu gěi nǐ sòng yì zhī huā.
english: Your boyfriend is really romantic – he brings you a single flower every day.

chinese: 中国各地的生活习惯各不相同，拿吃饭来说，南方人一般喜欢吃米饭，而北方人爱吃面条、馒头等面食。
pinyin: Zhōngguó gèdì de shēnghuó xíguàn gè bù xiāngtóng, ná chī fàn lái shuō, nánfāngrén yìbān xǐhuan chī mǐfàn, ér běifāngrén ài chī miàntiáo, mántou děng miànshí.
english: Lifestyles vary across China. Take eating habits, for example: people in the south generally prefer rice, whilst those in the north favour noodles, steamed buns and other wheat-based foods.

chinese: 科技改变了人类的生活，拿交通来说，高铁的出现使人们的日常出行更快、更方便了。
pinyin: Kējì gǎibiànle rénlèi de shēnghuó, ná jiāotōng lái shuō, gāotiě de chūxiàn shǐ rénmen de rìcháng chūxíng gèng kuài, gèng fāngbiàn le.
english: Technology has transformed people's lives. Take transport, for example: the advent of high-speed rail has made people's daily journeys faster and more convenient.

chinese: 我保证今后再也不迟到了。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎozhèng jīnhòu zài yě bù chídào le.
english: I promise I won't be late again in future.

chinese: 大学毕业以后，我再也没见过他。
pinyin: Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, wǒ zài yě méi jiànguo tā.
english: I haven't seen him since I graduated from university.

chinese: 他们跑了好几家医院，怎么也没查出孩子生病的原因。
pinyin: Tāmen pǎole hǎo jǐ jiā yīyuàn, zěnme yě méi cháchū háizi shēngbìng de yuányīn.
english: They visited several hospitals, but they simply couldn't find out what was wrong with their child.

chinese: 尽管每天细心照顾，可阳台上的花怎么都不开。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn měitiān xìxīn zhàogù, kě yángtái shàng de huā zěnme dōu bù kāi.
english: Despite tending to them carefully every day, the flowers on the balcony simply won't bloom.

chinese: 为了梦想而努力的人值得我们学习。
pinyin: Wèile mèngxiǎng ér nǔlì de rén zhíde wǒmen xuéxí.
english: People who strive to achieve their dreams are an inspiration to us all.

chinese: 我们减少使用塑料袋，是为了保护环境而改变习惯。
pinyin: Wǒmen jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng sùliàodài, shì wèile bǎohù huánjìng ér gǎibiàn xíguàn.
english: We are reducing our use of plastic bags as a way of changing our habits to protect the environment.

chinese: 虽然日子过得很难，但也不能过一天是一天。
pinyin: Suīrán rìzi guò de hěn nán, dàn yě bùnéng guò yì tiān shì yì tiān.
english: Although life is tough, we can't just take each day as it comes.

chinese: 要学的内容实在太多了，学一点儿是一点儿吧。
pinyin: Yào xué de nèiróng shízài tài duō le, xué yìdiǎnr shì yìdiǎnr ba.
english: There's simply so much to learn; I'll just take it bit by bit.

chinese: 想好了就直接做，有什么好害怕的。
pinyin: Xiǎnghǎole jiù zhíjiē zuò, yǒu shénme hǎo hàipà de.
english: Once you've made up your mind, just go for it – what's there to be afraid of?

chinese: 只是一次考试没考好，没有什么好难过的。
pinyin: Zhǐshì yí cì kǎoshì méi kǎohǎo, méiyǒu shénme hǎo nánguò de.
english: It's just one exam you didn't do well in; there's no need to feel down about it.

chinese: 他是他，我是我，我们的意见不一样。
pinyin: Tā shì tā, wǒ shì wǒ, wǒmen de yìjiàn bù yíyàng.
english: He is him, I am me; we have different opinions.

chinese: 工作是工作，家庭是家庭，不要用工作的方式解决家里的问题。
pinyin: Gōngzuò shì gōngzuò, jiātíng shì jiātíng, bú yào yòng gōngzuò de fāngshì jiějué jiā lǐ de wèntí.
english: Work is work, and family is family; don't use work methods to solve problems at home.

chinese: 这场会议很重要，你去也得去，不去也得去。
pinyin: Zhè chǎng huìyì hěn zhòngyào, nǐ qù yě děi qù, bú qù yě děi qù.
english: This meeting is very important; you have to go, whether you want to or not.

chinese: 结果改变不了了，你接受也得接受，不接受也得接受。
pinyin: Jiéguǒ gǎibiàn bu liǎo le, nǐ jiēshòu yě děi jiēshòu, bù jiēshòu yě děi jiēshòu.
english: The outcome can't be changed; you'll have to accept it whether you like it or not.

chinese: 别浪费时间了，有什么想法说就是了。
pinyin: Bié làngfèi shíjiān le, yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ shuō jiùshì le.
english: Don't waste any time – if you've got any ideas, just say so.

chinese: 你不要生气，下次别答应他就是了。
pinyin: Nǐ bú yào shēngqì, xià cì bié dāying tā jiùshì le.
english: Don't get angry; just don't agree to it next time.

chinese: 还国际公司呢，服务质量这么差。
pinyin: Hái guójì gōngsī ne, fúwù zhìliàng zhème chà.
english: And to call themselves an international company, with service of such poor quality.

chinese: 还中文专业的呢，中文说得还不如我。
pinyin: Hái Zhōngwén zhuānyè de ne, Zhōngwén shuō de hái bùrú wǒ.
english: And to think he's a Chinese language student – his Chinese isn't even as good as mine.

chinese: 我不饿，你吃你的吧，不用等我。
pinyin: Wǒ bú è, nǐ chī nǐ de ba, búyòng děng wǒ.
english: I'm not hungry; you go ahead and eat—don't wait for me.

chinese: 没有什么重要的事，你忙你的吧。
pinyin: Méiyǒu shénme zhòngyào de shì, nǐ máng nǐ de ba.
english: It's nothing important; just carry on with what you're doing.

chinese: 老师让你多练你就多练，肯定没坏处。
pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng nǐ duō liàn nǐ jiù duō liàn, kěndìng méi huàichù.
english: If your teacher tells you to practise more, then practise more—it certainly can't do any harm.

chinese: 叫你拿着你就拿着，不用跟我客气。
pinyin: Jiào nǐ názhe nǐ jiù názhe, búyòng gēn wǒ kèqi.
english: If I tell you to take it, just take it – no need to stand on ceremony.

chinese: 他受伤了，我说什么也得去看看他。
pinyin: Tā shòushāng le, wǒ shuō shénme yě děi qù kànkan tā.
english: He's been injured, so I simply have to go and see him.

chinese: 快要迟到了，说什么也得走了。
pinyin: Kuàiyào chídào le, shuō shénme yě děi zǒu le.
english: I'm about to be late, so I've got to go, no matter what.

chinese: 这么有用的技术，我怎么（着）也得学。
pinyin: Zhème yǒuyòng de jìshù, wǒ zěnme (zhe) yě děi xué.
english: A technique this useful—I simply must learn it.

chinese: 买就买（点儿）吧，也不太贵。
pinyin: Mǎi jiù mǎi (diǎnr) ba, yě bú tài guì.
english: Let's just buy a few, then—it's not that expensive.

chinese: 慢就慢（点儿）吧，能做完就行。
pinyin: Màn jiù màn (diǎnr) ba, néng zuòwán jiù xíng.
english: It'll take a bit longer, but as long as it gets done, that's fine.

chinese: 我们讨论是讨论了，可是大家各有各的想法。
pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùn shì tǎolùn le, kěshì dàjiā gè yǒu gè de xiǎngfǎ.
english: We did have a discussion, but everyone had their own views.

chinese: 留学生活累是累，不过我们学到了很多知识。
pinyin: Liúxué shēnghuó lèi shì lèi, búguò wǒmen xuédàole hěn duō zhīshi.
english: Life as an international student is certainly tiring, but we've learnt a great deal.

chinese: 面试的时候，我心里紧张死了。
pinyin: Miànshì de shíhou, wǒ xīnli jǐnzhāng sǐle.
english: I was absolutely terrified during the interview.

chinese: 不知道从哪儿来的声音，吵死了。
pinyin: Bù zhīdao cóng nǎr lái de shēngyīn, chǎo sǐle.
english: I don't know where that noise is coming from, but it's absolutely deafening.

chinese: 吃完冰激凌，我突然牙疼得厉害。
pinyin: Chīwán bīngjilíng, wǒ tūrán yá téng de lìhai.
english: After eating the ice cream, I suddenly had a terrible toothache.

chinese: 我们这儿有个同学病得很厉害，请你们赶快来看看。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhèr yǒu ge tóngxué bìng de hěn lìhai, qǐng nǐmen gǎnkuài lái kànkan.
english: One of our classmates here is very ill; please come and have a look at them straight away.

chinese: 你点了这么多菜，咱们两个人吃得了吗？
pinyin: Nǐ diǎnle zhème duō cài, zánmen liǎng ge rén chī de liǎo ma?
english: You've ordered so much food – will there be enough for the two of us?

chinese: 我帮你一起做，下班之前肯定完成得了。
pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ yìqǐ zuò, xià bān zhīqián kěndìng wánchéng de liǎo.
english: I'll help you with it; we'll definitely get it done before the end of the working day.

chinese: 行李太重了，我一个人拿不了。
pinyin: Xíngli tài zhòng le, wǒ yí ge rén ná bu liǎo.
english: The luggage is too heavy; I can't carry it on my own.

chinese: 明天的比赛他参加不了。
pinyin: Míngtiān de bǐsài tā cānjiā bu liǎo.
english: He won't be able to take part in tomorrow's match.

chinese: 作为学生，难道学习不是最重要的事情吗？
pinyin: Zuòwéi xuésheng, nándào xuéxí bú shì zuì zhòngyào de shìqing ma?
english: As a student, isn't studying the most important thing?

chinese: 工作出了问题，你难道不应该负责吗？
pinyin: Gōngzuò chūle wèntí, nǐ nándào bù yīnggāi fùzé ma?
english: If something goes wrong at work, shouldn't you take responsibility?

chinese: 这么有名的作家，谁不认识他？
pinyin: Zhème yǒumíng de zuòjiā, shéi bú rènshi tā?
english: He's such a famous writer – who doesn't know him?

chinese: 他去哪儿从来不说，我怎么会知道呢？
pinyin: Tā qù nǎr cónglái bù shuō, wǒ zěnme huì zhīdao ne?
english: He never tells me where he's going, so how am I supposed to know?

chinese: 事情这么多，我哪儿有时间出去旅游啊？
pinyin: Shìqing zhème duō, wǒ nǎr yǒu shíjiān chūqù lǚyóu a?
english: With so much going on, when on earth would I find the time to go on holiday?

chinese: 你再把那件衣服洗一洗。
pinyin: Nǐ zài bǎ nà jiàn yīfu xǐ yi xǐ.
english: Please wash that item of clothing again.

chinese: 你把窗户擦一擦，我把地板扫一扫
pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chuānghu cā yi cā, wǒ bǎ dìbǎn sǎo yi sǎo
english: You wipe the windows, and I'll sweep the floor.

chinese: 他把钱算了算，又取了一点儿出来。
pinyin: Tā bǎ qián suàn le suàn, yòu qǔle yìdiǎnr chūlái.
english: He counted the money and took a little more out.

chinese: 我把银行卡密码忘了。
pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yínhángkǎ mìmǎ wàng le.
english: I've forgotten my bank card PIN.

chinese: 他把新买的手机丢了。
pinyin: Tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shǒujī diū le.
english: He lost his new mobile phone.

chinese: 因为不收拾房间，妈妈把他批评了一顿。
pinyin: Yīnwèi bù shōushi fángjiān, māma bǎ tā pīpíngle yí dùn.
english: His mum gave him a telling-off for not tidying his room.

chinese: 同学们把课文读了两遍。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen bǎ kèwén dúle liǎng biàn.
english: The pupils read the text twice.

chinese: 他把这个问题认真地考虑了好几天。
pinyin: Tā bǎ zhège wèntí rènzhēn de kǎolǜle hǎo jǐ tiān.
english: He gave the matter serious thought for several days.

chinese: 你别把垃圾往地上扔。
pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ lājī wǎng dì shàng rēng.
english: Please don't throw rubbish on the ground.

chinese: 请大家把说明书认真读一读。
pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā bǎ shuōmíngshū rènzhēn dú yi dú.
english: Please do read the instructions carefully.

chinese: 我的自行车让朋友借去了。
pinyin: Wǒ de zìxíngchē ràng péngyou jièqù le.
english: I've lent my bike to a friend.

chinese: 相机叫谁拿走了？
pinyin: Xiàngjī jiào shéi názǒu le?
english: Who took the camera?

chinese: 老师表扬我取得了好成绩。
pinyin: Lǎoshī biǎoyáng wǒ qǔdéle hǎo chéngjì.
english: My teacher praised me for my good results.

chinese: 警察表扬那个小伙子帮助了别人。
pinyin: Jǐngchá biǎoyáng nàge xiǎohuǒzi bāngzhùle biéren.
english: The police commended the young man for helping others.

chinese: 妈妈总是批评我不收拾房间。
pinyin: Māma zǒngshì pīpíng wǒ bù shōushi fángjiān.
english: Mum is always telling me off for not tidying my room.

chinese: 经理批评我没带会议资料。
pinyin: Jīnglǐ pīpíng wǒ méi dài huìyì zīliào.
english: The manager criticised me for not bringing the meeting documents.

chinese: 同学们选我做小组长。
pinyin: Tóngxuémen xuǎn wǒ zuò xiǎozǔzhǎng.
english: My classmates elected me as group leader.

chinese: 大家想选他当队长。
pinyin: Dàjiā xiǎng xuǎn tā dāng duìzhǎng.
english: Everyone wants to elect him as captain.

chinese: 张教授同意收我为学生。
pinyin: Zhāng jiàoshòu tóngyì shōu wǒ wéi xuésheng.
english: Professor Zhang agreed to take me on as a student.

chinese: 这件事使我改变了对她的印象。
pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ gǎibiànle duì tā de yìnxiàng.
english: This incident changed my impression of her.

chinese: 那些美好的回忆让我永远难忘。
pinyin: Nàxiē měihǎo de huíyì ràng wǒ yǒngyuǎn nánwàng.
english: Those wonderful memories will stay with me forever.

chinese: 现在堵车，打车不如坐地铁快。
pinyin: Xiànzài dǔchē, dǎ chē bùrú zuò dìtiě kuài.
english: There's a traffic jam at the moment, so taking a taxi isn't as quick as taking the underground.

chinese: 我觉得玩游戏不如看小说有意思。
pinyin: Wǒ juéde wán yóuxì bùrú kàn xiǎoshuō yǒuyìsi.
english: I think reading novels is more interesting than playing games.

chinese: 跟线下购物相比，上网买东西更符合年轻人的习惯。
pinyin: Gēn xiànxià gòuwù xiāngbǐ, shàngwǎng mǎi dōngxi gèng fúhé niánqīngrén de xíguàn.
english: Compared with shopping in-store, online shopping is more in line with young people's habits.

chinese: 跟其他公司相比，我们的产品不但便宜，而且服务也好。
pinyin: Gēn qítā gōngsī xiāngbǐ, wǒmen de chǎnpǐn búdàn piányi, érqiě fúwù yě hǎo.
english: Compared with other companies, our products are not only cheaper but our service is also excellent.

chinese: 没有学生不喜欢放假。
pinyin: Méiyǒu xuésheng bù xǐhuan fàngjià.
english: There isn't a single pupil who doesn't like the holidays.

chinese: 这么重要的内容老师不可能没讲过。
pinyin: Zhème zhòngyào de nèiróng lǎoshī bù kěnéng méi jiǎngguo.
english: The teacher couldn't possibly have left out such important material.

chinese: 他不是不想帮忙，而是确实没时间。
pinyin: Tā bú shì bù xiǎng bāngmáng, érshì quèshí méi shíjiān.
english: It's not that he doesn't want to help; it's just that he really doesn't have the time.

chinese: 我不是不爱喝咖啡，而是担心晚上睡不着。
pinyin: Wǒ bú shì bú ài hē kāfēi, érshì dānxīn wǎnshang shuì bu zháo.
english: It's not that I don't like coffee; it's just that I'm worried I won't be able to sleep at night.

chinese: 这个牌子的奶茶既好喝，又健康。
pinyin: Zhège páizi de nǎichá jì hǎohē, yòu jiànkāng.
english: This brand's bubble tea is both delicious and healthy.

chinese: 我每天骑自行车上学，这样既能锻炼身体，也对环境保护有帮助。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān qí zìxíngchē shàng xué, zhèyàng jì néng duànliàn shēntǐ, yě duì huánjìng bǎohù yǒu bāngzhù.
english: I cycle to school every day; this not only keeps me fit but also helps protect the environment.

chinese: 参加文化活动一方面可以增长知识，另一方面可以认识新的朋友。
pinyin: Cānjiā wénhuà huódòng yì fāngmiàn kěyǐ zēngzhǎng zhīshi, lìng yì fāngmiàn kěyǐ rènshi xīn de péngyou.
english: Taking part in cultural activities not only broadens one's knowledge but also provides an opportunity to make new friends.

chinese: 想要解决大城市堵车的问题，一方面要提高公共交通服务质量，另一方面要让人们养成绿色出行的习惯。
pinyin: Xiǎng yào jiějué dà chéngshì dǔchē de wèntí, yì fāngmiàn yào tígāo gōnggòng jiāotōng fúwù zhìliàng, lìng yì fāngmiàn yào ràng rénmen yǎngchéng lǜsè chūxíng de xíguàn.
english: To tackle the problem of traffic congestion in major cities, we need, on the one hand, to improve the quality of public transport services and, on the other, to encourage people to adopt eco-friendly travel habits.

chinese: 选择职业的时候，应该首先了解自己的性格、能力，其次再考虑工资、收入等方面的问题。
pinyin: Xuǎnzé zhíyè de shíhou, yīnggāi shǒuxiān liǎojiě zìjǐ de xìnggé, nénglì, qícì zài kǎolǜ gōngzī, shōurù děng fāngmiàn de wèntí.
english: When choosing a career, you should first understand your own personality and abilities, and only then consider matters such as salary and income.

chinese: 我学汉语首先是因为对中国文化感兴趣，其次是为了获得更多的工作机会。
pinyin: Wǒ xué Hànyǔ shǒuxiān shì yīnwèi duì Zhōngguó wénhuà gǎn xìngqù, qícì shì wèile huòdé gèng duō de gōngzuò jīhuì.
english: I am learning Chinese, firstly because I am interested in Chinese culture, and secondly to gain more job opportunities.

chinese: 首先要找到一个合适的目标，然后坚持学习，这样才能学好中文。
pinyin: Shǒuxiān yào zhǎodào yí ge héshì de mùbiāo, ránhòu jiānchí xuéxí, zhèyàng cái néng xuéhǎo Zhōngwén.
english: First, you need to set yourself a suitable goal, and then keep at it; that's the only way to learn Chinese properly.

chinese: 校长首先对同学们表示欢迎，然后介绍了学校的一些基本情况。
pinyin: Xiàozhǎng shǒuxiān duì tóngxuémen biǎoshì huānyíng, ránhòu jièshàole xuéxiào de yìxiē jīběn qíngkuàng.
english: The headteacher began by welcoming the pupils, and then provided an overview of the school.

chinese: 人们喜欢一边喝咖啡，一边聊天儿，于是城市里的咖啡馆越来越多。
pinyin: Rénmen xǐhuan yìbiān hē kāfēi, yìbiān liáotiānr, yúshì chéngshì lǐ de kāfēiguǎn yuèláiyuè duō.
english: People enjoy having a chat whilst drinking coffee, so there are more and more cafés in the city.

chinese: 大家不断地鼓励我，于是我决定报名参加这个比赛。
pinyin: Dàjiā búduàn de gǔlì wǒ, yúshì wǒ juédìng bàomíng cānjiā zhège bǐsài.
english: Everyone kept encouraging me, so I decided to enter this competition.

chinese: 为了锻炼身体，我一有空就去健身房，甚至专门请了一个健身教练。
pinyin: Wèile duànliàn shēntǐ, wǒ yì yǒu kòng jiù qù jiànshēnfáng, shènzhì zhuānmén qǐngle yí ge jiànshēn jiàoliàn.
english: To keep fit, I go to the gym whenever I have a spare moment; I've even hired a personal trainer.

chinese: 收到大学的入学通知，我高兴极了，甚至觉得自己是世界上最幸福的人。
pinyin: Shōudào dàxué de rùxué tōngzhī, wǒ gāoxìng jíle, shènzhì juéde zìjǐ shì shìjiè shàng zuì xìngfú de rén.
english: When I received my university offer, I was absolutely delighted; I even felt as though I was the happiest person in the world.

chinese: 我们学习生词，不仅要理解词语的意思，而且应该知道怎么使用。
pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxí shēngcí, bùjǐn yào lǐjiě cíyǔ de yìsi, érqiě yīnggāi zhīdao zěnme shǐyòng.
english: When we learn new words, we should not only understand their meanings, but also know how to use them.

chinese: 这里不光有美丽的风景，还有各种少见的动物、植物。
pinyin: Zhèlǐ bùguāng yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng, hái yǒu gèzhǒng shǎojiàn de dòngwù, zhíwù.
english: Not only does this place boast beautiful scenery, but it is also home to a wide variety of rare animals and plants.

chinese: 经过四年的努力，他终于顺利毕业，并且有了一家自己的公司。
pinyin: Jīngguò sì nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú shùnlì bìyè, bìngqiě yǒule yì jiā zìjǐ de gōngsī.
english: After four years of hard work, he finally graduated successfully and now has his own company.

chinese: 随着经济的发展，人们的生活水平提高了，并且对健康和生活质量的要求也越来越高。
pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó shuǐpíng tígāo le, bìngqiě duì jiànkāng hé shēnghuó zhìliàng de yāoqiú yě yuèláiyuè gāo.
english: With economic development, people's standard of living has improved, and their expectations regarding health and quality of life have also risen.

chinese: 我有时候连老师说的话也听不懂，听广播就更难了。
pinyin: Wǒ yǒu shíhou lián lǎoshī shuō de huà yě tīng bu dǒng, tīng guǎngbō jiù gèng nán le.
english: Sometimes I can't even understand what the teacher is saying, let alone the radio.

chinese: 受伤以后，他连走路都困难，踢足球更不可能了。
pinyin: Shòushāng yǐhòu, tā lián zǒulù dōu kùnnan, tī zúqiú gèng bù kěnéng le.
english: After his injury, he found it difficult even to walk, let alone play football.

chinese: 毕业以后，同学们不是留在中国继续学习，就是回国工作。
pinyin: Bìyè yǐhòu, tóngxuémen bú shì liú zài Zhōngguó jìxù xuéxí, jiùshì huí guó gōngzuò.
english: After graduation, the students either stayed in China to continue their studies or returned to their home countries to work.

chinese: 周末他不是在游泳馆游泳，就是在篮球场打篮球。
pinyin: Zhōumò tā bú shì zài yóuyǒngguǎn yóuyǒng, jiùshì zài lánqiúchǎng dǎ lánqiú.
english: At the weekend, he's either swimming at the swimming pool or playing basketball on the court.

chinese: 尽管收入不高，但是我对这份工作很满意。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn shōurù bù gāo, dànshì wǒ duì zhè fèn gōngzuò hěn mǎnyì.
english: Although the pay isn't great, I'm very happy with this job.

chinese: 尽管已经很晚了，可是她仍然在学习。
pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, kěshì tā réngrán zài xuéxí.
english: Although it was already late, she was still studying.

chinese: 我知道那部电影很有意思，然而太忙了，一直没时间看。
pinyin: Wǒ zhīdao nà bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuyìsi, rán'ér tài máng le, yìzhí méi shíjiān kàn.
english: I know that film is really interesting, but I've been so busy that I haven't had time to watch it yet.

chinese: 她以为能轻松通过考试，然而成绩却不太好。
pinyin: Tā yǐwéi néng qīngsōng tōngguò kǎoshì, rán'ér chéngjì què bú tài hǎo.
english: She thought she would pass the exam with ease, but her results weren't very good.

chinese: 我很想参加你的生日晚会，不过我明天有考试，得好好复习。
pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng cānjiā nǐ de shēngrì wǎnhuì, búguò wǒ míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, děi hǎohǎo fùxí.
english: I'd really love to come to your birthday party, but I've got an exam tomorrow, so I need to study hard.

chinese: 他只学了三个月中文，不过已经说得不错了。
pinyin: Tā zhǐ xuéle sān ge yuè Zhōngwén, búguò yǐjīng shuō de búcuò le.
english: He's only been learning Chinese for three months, but he's already quite good at it.

chinese: 这些衣服便宜是便宜，就是感觉质量不太好。
pinyin: Zhèxiē yīfu piányi shì piányi, jiùshì gǎnjué zhìliàng bú tài hǎo.
english: These clothes are cheap, yes, but they don't feel very good quality.

chinese: 小张这个人聪明是聪明，不过有时候比较懒。
pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng zhège rén cōngming shì cōngming, búguò yǒu shíhou bǐjiào lǎn.
english: Zhang is certainly clever, but he can be a bit lazy at times.

chinese: 你下了飞机记得给妈妈打个电话，否则她会一直担心你。
pinyin: Nǐ xiàle fēijī jìde gěi māma dǎ ge diànhuà, fǒuzé tā huì yìzhí dānxīn nǐ.
english: Remember to ring Mum as soon as you get off the plane, otherwise she'll be worried sick about you.

chinese: 课后一定要经常复习，否则很快就会忘记。
pinyin: Kè hòu yídìng yào jīngcháng fùxí, fǒuzé hěn kuài jiù huì wàngjì.
english: You must revise regularly after class, otherwise you will forget it very quickly.

chinese: 你要是想取得成功，就必须坚持到底。
pinyin: Nǐ yàoshi xiǎng qǔdé chénggōng, jiù bìxū jiānchí dàodǐ.
english: If you want to succeed, you must see it through to the end.

chinese: 要是人人都能节约用水，地球的环境就能得到更好的保护。
pinyin: Yàoshi rénrén dōu néng jiéyuē yòngshuǐ, dìqiú de huánjìng jiù néng dédào gèng hǎo de bǎohù.
english: If everyone were to conserve water, the Earth's environment would be better protected.

chinese: 要是你打算假期去旅游，就提前上网订票，否则到时候就买不到了。
pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dǎsuàn jiàqī qù lǚyóu, jiù tíqián shàngwǎng dìng piào, fǒuzé dào shíhou jiù mǎi bu dào le.
english: If you're planning to go on holiday, book your tickets online in advance, otherwise you won't be able to get any when the time comes.

chinese: 要是你不常穿，最好就不要买，否则买了也是浪费。
pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ bù cháng chuān, zuìhǎo jiù bú yào mǎi, fǒuzé mǎile yě shì làngfèi.
english: If you don't wear it very often, it's best not to buy it; otherwise, it'll just be a waste of money.

chinese: 不管在什么地方，说话、办事都要有礼貌。
pinyin: Bùguǎn zài shénme dìfang, shuōhuà, bànshì dōu yào yǒu lǐmào.
english: Wherever you are, you should always be polite in your speech and conduct.

chinese: 不管别人怎么说，我也不会改变主意。
pinyin: Bùguǎn biéren zěnme shuō, wǒ yě bú huì gǎibiàn zhǔyi.
english: No matter what anyone says, I won't change my mind.

chinese: 无论在多么紧张的情况下，他都表现得非常冷静。
pinyin: Wúlùn zài duōme jǐnzhāng de qíngkuàng xià, tā dōu biǎoxiàn de fēicháng lěngjìng.
english: No matter how tense the situation, he always remained very calm.

chinese: 无论遇到多大的困难，我们也不应该随便放弃。
pinyin: Wúlùn yùdào duō dà de kùnnan, wǒmen yě bù yīnggāi suíbiàn fàngqì.
english: No matter how great the difficulties we face, we should never give up without good reason.

chinese: 既然你这么喜欢小孩儿，毕业以后就当老师吧。
pinyin: Jìrán nǐ zhème xǐhuan xiǎoháir, bìyè yǐhòu jiù dāng lǎoshī ba.
english: Since you're so fond of children, why not become a teacher after you graduate?

chinese: 既然来了，就进屋喝杯茶吧。
pinyin: Jìrán lái le, jiù jìn wū hē bēi chá ba.
english: Now that you're here, why not come in for a cup of tea?

chinese: 由于您没带护照，因此不能办理银行卡。
pinyin: Yóuyú nín méi dài hùzhào, yīncǐ bù néng bànlǐ yínhángkǎ.
english: As you have not brought your passport with you, you cannot apply for a bank card.

chinese: 我对京剧很感兴趣，因此报名参加了这次活动。
pinyin: Wǒ duì jīngjù hěn gǎn xìngqù, yīncǐ bàomíng cānjiāle zhè cì huódòng.
english: I am very interested in Peking Opera, which is why I signed up for this event.

chinese: 我每天都给父母打电话，好让他们放心。
pinyin: Wǒ měitiān dōu gěi fùmǔ dǎ diànhuà, hǎo ràng tāmen fàngxīn.
english: I ring my parents every day to put their minds at ease.

chinese: 我们应该多鼓励他，好让他有信心。
pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi duō gǔlì tā, hǎo ràng tā yǒu xìnxīn.
english: We should give him more encouragement to boost his confidence.

chinese: 你即使干到明天早上，恐怕也干不完。
pinyin: Nǐ jíshǐ gàn dào míngtiān zǎoshang, kǒngpà yě gànbuwán.
english: Even if you carried on working until tomorrow morning, I'm afraid you wouldn't finish it.

chinese: 即使工作再忙，也要常回家看看父母。
pinyin: Jíshǐ gōngzuò zài máng, yě yào cháng huí jiā kànkan fùmǔ.
english: No matter how busy you are at work, you should make a point of visiting your parents from time to time.

chinese: 我今天晚上就是不睡觉，也必须解决这个问题。
pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang jiùshì bú shuìjiào, yě bìxū jiějué zhège wèntí.
english: I'm not going to sleep tonight; I simply must sort this out.

chinese: 你就是不同意，我也不会改变自己的决定。
pinyin: Nǐ jiùshì bù tóngyì, wǒ yě bú huì gǎibiàn zìjǐ de juédìng.
english: Even if you disagree, I won't change my mind.

chinese: 你着急你先走吧。
pinyin: Nǐ zháojí nǐ xiān zǒu ba.
english: If you're in a hurry, you go on ahead.

chinese: 站得高看得远。
pinyin: Zhàn de gāo kàn de yuǎn.
english: The higher you stand, the further you can see.

chinese: 他同意我不同意。
pinyin: Tā tóngyì wǒ bù tóngyì.
english: He agreed that I disagreed.

chinese: 今晚我不睡觉也要把作业写完。
pinyin: Jīnwǎn wǒ bú shuìjiào yě yào bǎ zuòyè xiěwán.
english: I'll finish my homework tonight, even if it means staying up all night.

chinese: 你不喜欢做也得做。
pinyin: Nǐ bù xǐhuan zuò yě děi zuò.
english: You'll have to do it even if you don't like it.

chinese: 我们的宿舍楼有三百来间房。
pinyin: Wǒmen de sùshèlóu yǒu sānbǎi lái jiān fáng.
english: Our hall of residence has around three hundred rooms.

chinese: 书架上放着一百来本书。
pinyin: Shūjià shàng fàngzhe yìbǎi lái běn shū.
english: There are about a hundred books on the bookshelf.

chinese: 这条大鱼估计有十来斤重。
pinyin: Zhè tiáo dà yú gūjì yǒu shí lái jīn zhòng.
english: This big fish probably weighs about ten jin.

chinese: 客人大约下午两点到公司参观。
pinyin: Kèrén dàyuē xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn dào gōngsī cānguān.
english: The visitors are due to arrive at the company for a tour at around 2.00 pm.

chinese: 我的中文老师四十岁左右。
pinyin: Wǒ de Zhōngwén lǎoshī sìshí suì zuǒyòu.
english: My Chinese teacher is around forty years old.

chinese: 春节前后，很多商场有打折活动。
pinyin: Chūn Jié qiánhòu, hěn duō shāngchǎng yǒu dǎzhé huódòng.
english: Around the time of the Spring Festival, many shopping centres run sales.

chinese: 零点五、三分之一、百分之二十、两倍
pinyin: Líng diǎn wǔ, sān fēn zhī yī, bǎi fēn zhī èrshí, liǎng bèi.
english: 0.5, one-third, 20 per cent, twice

chinese: 老师听写了二十个汉字，每个汉字零点五分，一共十分。
pinyin: Lǎoshī tīngxiěle èrshí ge Hànzì, měi ge Hànzì líng diǎn wǔ fēn, yígòng shí fēn.
english: The teacher set a dictation of twenty Chinese characters, worth 0.5 marks each, totalling 10 marks.

chinese: 我们班有三分之一的同学没去过长城。
pinyin: Wǒmen bān yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de tóngxué méi qùguo Chángchéng.
english: A third of the pupils in our class have never been to the Great Wall.

chinese: 跟去年相比，今年游客的数量减少了百分之二十。
pinyin: Gēn qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián yóukè de shùliàng jiǎnshǎole bǎi fēn zhī èrshí.
english: Compared with last year, the number of visitors this year has fallen by twenty per cent.

chinese: 我的收入比去年提高了两倍。
pinyin: Wǒ de shōurù bǐ qùnián tígāole liǎng bèi.
english: My income has tripled compared with last year.
